upcoming_games.name: CREAMPIE GIRLS
upcoming_games.description: CREAMPIE GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

upcoming_games.name: HOT HALLOWEEN
upcoming_games.description: HOT HALLOWEEN - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

upcoming_games.name: Kovan-G
upcoming_games.description: Be the queen's scent: lead a living swarm of hundreds of honeybees to the flowers with your mouse and carry the honey home to a straw skep. Cook hornets in a heat ball, scatter from diving swallows and keep the colony fed through 12 summer days.

upcoming_games.name: The Worldtree and the Omamori Promise
upcoming_games.description: Explore the Worldtree, gather materials, craft Omamori, and venture deeper. Navigate randomly changing paths, face rising Worldtree Pressure, and continue your adventure even after defeat. Strengthen your party, upgrade equipment, and uncover the secrets of the Worldtree in this fantasy RPG.

upcoming_games.name: StackProsper
upcoming_games.description: Drop one card onto another and watch a 13th-century kingdom grow. Gather, build and raise your people, survive the seasons and hostile neighbors, then win by conquering their capitals or completing a grand cathedral.

upcoming_games.name: WeirdBus
upcoming_games.description: One bus. Four wheels. A whole lot of bad decisions. Share control of an uncooperative bus, rescue flying passengers and cross cities, canyons, ice and swamps on the way to a megatower roof. Play solo or argue your way to the finish with up to three friends.

upcoming_games.name: Radio Fox Hunt
upcoming_games.description: Radio Fox Hunt is a simulator inspired by the sport of amateur radio direction finding.

upcoming_games.name: Scrap Cascade
upcoming_games.description: Turn junk into a chain reaction in a compact factory strategy game. Connect machines, recycle waste and pick upgrade cards that change your plan. Grow through five contracts, adapt to new buyers and build a production line worth running again.

upcoming_games.name: Task Bar Quest
upcoming_games.description: A free idle RPG that lives at the edge of your desktop. Choose your hero, battle monsters and bosses, collect powerful gear, and grow stronger with companions, crafting, mining, and fishing while you go about your day.

upcoming_games.name: Elya
upcoming_games.description: An AI companion for your desktop. Interact, chat, follow your bond level, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Steam Workshop creations.

upcoming_games.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks
upcoming_games.description: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across a cozy toy shop floor. Sort each one onto the shelf for its shape and into the bin for its color, alone or in online co-op for up to 4. Play the 14-room Campaign, or put all 114 shapes on the floor at once in Cozy Mode.

upcoming_games.name: MAID FOR YOU!
upcoming_games.description: Three maids. Thirty nights. One table, kept just for you. While the manager is away, Aoi, Reina and Akane open the café after hours for a single guest. Play 11 mini-games they host themselves, win them over one stage at a time, and come home to a café that remembers you. Fully voiced in Japanese.

upcoming_games.name: 退租清算公司
upcoming_games.description: Take over a nearly bankrupt move-out clearance company and clean up the homes tenants left behind. Clear trash, scrub away grime, uncover forgotten valuables, appraise mysterious finds, sell or collect them, and grow your business. One person’s junk might just be your next big score.

upcoming_games.name: Mayday Airways
upcoming_games.description: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.

upcoming_games.name: Tri Chapas
upcoming_games.description: Tri Chapas is a tactical, physics-based tabletop football game inspired by classic coin soccer. Flick one disc between the other two, never touch them, stay onside and work your way up the pitch to the goal. Plan the pass. Score the goal.

upcoming_games.name: Tiny Touches - A Cozy Customization Shop
upcoming_games.description: Run a tiny customization shop with no timers and no pressure. Paint, pattern and decorate phone cases, keyboards and controllers, swap their parts, and hand them back to the neighbors at your window while rain taps the glass and the radio hums.

upcoming_games.name: Shine Carpets Together
upcoming_games.description: Foam it, scrub it, rinse it, squeegee it. Shine Carpets Together is a cozy co-op cleaning game for 1–4 players: take orders in your little rug shop, restore filthy kilims layer by layer with real flowing water, and deliver them sparkling.

upcoming_games.name: Find the Four Leaf Clover
upcoming_games.description: Somewhere in a mountain of millions of clover leaves hides one four-leaf clover. Dig by hand with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sell the fiber, then build belts and machines that dig for you. Find all 24 rare species for your Botanical Album.

upcoming_games.name: Find The Needle Together
upcoming_games.description: Millions of straws, one needle. Dig through giant haystacks with up to 3 friends in online co-op with proximity voice chat, sell the hay, then build belts and machines that dig for you. Find all 24 hidden needles for your Pincushion.

upcoming_games.name: BitLoaf
upcoming_games.description: BitLoaf turns your Windows desktop into a living, interactive 3D world. Expressive bread characters wander, snack, socialize, and play on their own while you work, or step in anytime to toss props around, arrange their space, and kick off games.

upcoming_games.name: Tidy Up: Street Market
upcoming_games.description: Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. Over 6,000 items are piled up around an open-air market: fruit, fish, shoes, flowers, toys and more. Carry each one to the right stall, earn money, buy upgrades, and turn a messy street into a full, colorful market.

upcoming_games.name: Sploink
upcoming_games.description: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

upcoming_games.name: Woodturning Simulator
upcoming_games.description: A cute, chaotic 1-4 player online co-op workshop! Turn a giant spinning block into whatever the customer ordered - wood, ice, jelly, chocolate, gold and more - paint it, stick on googly parts, then drag your wobbly masterpiece to the truck.

upcoming_games.name: Buy the Dip, Milady
upcoming_games.description: Let the maids fight. You handle the money! Mine silver, summon maids, and buy or short stocks while battle rages. Your profits might turn the tide. Your losses? Back to the pickaxe. Build your team for story battles, the Endless Tower, and ranked Steam PvP. No paid pulls.

upcoming_games.name: Rustlers Online
upcoming_games.description: Rope a rooftop, swing over the street and settle it with a six-shooter. RUSTLERS is a cartoon Wild West shooter with 8-player PvP, a lasso that does it all, six modes from high-noon duels to the Black Stallion's night hunt, 20+ period guns and 11 maps.

upcoming_games.name: Bullet Factory
upcoming_games.description: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

upcoming_games.name: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape
upcoming_games.description: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.

upcoming_games.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
upcoming_games.description: A 4X asynchronous galactic strategy game. Eight houses, one shattered galaxy, two to eight commanders. Design fleets, fight three-band battles with named captains, and take your turn when you have ten minutes. Campaigns can run for weeks without a fixed game night.

upcoming_games.name: Hungry Hoist
upcoming_games.description: Hungry Hoist is a co-op dungeon-crawler sandbox about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with. Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda!

upcoming_games.name: Tavern Clicker
upcoming_games.description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

upcoming_games.name: CASHGRAB
upcoming_games.description: CASHGRAB is an arcade time-attack 2D platformer. Play as Joey, a duck who sold the rights to a movie adaptation of his last adventure. He has to run, jump, stomp and dash to defeat enemies and grab the cash as fast as he can because the producers want to complete the movie as fast as possible!

upcoming_games.name: PomoIdle Arena
upcoming_games.description: A Pomodoro timer × idle × command-battle RPG. Resources build up while you work — pull commands, power up your party, and battle other players between sessions. Your focused time becomes your strength.

upcoming_games.name: Game Shelver 99: I must organize my Steam Library and defend it against pirates with a shotgun
upcoming_games.description: YOU MUST ORGANIZE YOUR STEAM LIBRARY AND DEFEND IT AGAINST PIRATES WITH A SHOTGUN! Play solo or co-op and bring up to three friends.

upcoming_games.name: Paw's Boba Shop
upcoming_games.description: Paw's Boba Shop is a boba shop management game where you can mix tea bases and serve drinks to cute animal customers. Muddle fruit, juice fruit, blend smoothies, and top drinks with candy, cookies, and more. No timers. No pressure. Play at your own pace.

upcoming_games.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
upcoming_games.description: Deckbuilding roguelike with new twists! Over 30 heroes whose abilities warp the rules, hundreds of summons, spells and artifacts to discover. And you can even DESIGN YOUR OWN cards at the Forge!

upcoming_games.name: Shirt Happens!
upcoming_games.description: Build a T-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 6. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it.

upcoming_games.name: Grit & Greed
upcoming_games.description: How much can you take and get away with?

upcoming_games.name: Crowns & Tiles
upcoming_games.description: Crowns & Tiles is a cozy hex tile placement game where you shape a peaceful medieval kingdom, connect castles, forests, homes, and countryside, and grow your realm with every choice.

upcoming_games.name: Legacy of Legend
upcoming_games.description: Face-down bluffing and piercing strikes! 1v1 tactical turn-based card battle.

upcoming_games.name: Micro Party
upcoming_games.description: 150+ micro-games, 5 to 15 seconds each. 2-4 players on one keyboard. Most of it built with AI and I am not going to pretend otherwise.

upcoming_games.name: Tún
upcoming_games.description: Tún is a relaxing puzzle game in which you grow a garden at your own pace. Fulfill requests, expand your garden, decorate it as you see fit, and adopt cats. There is no "game over" and the game never becomes too stressful.

upcoming_games.name: Chromagami
upcoming_games.description: Team up with a comrade to fight an interdimensional paper war in this science-fiction, hero shooter.

upcoming_games.name: Tsuchinoko Fishing
upcoming_games.description: "Tsuchinoko Fishing" is a fishing romance adventure game. In this game, you'll fish in various locations, solve problems, and deepen your relationship with the heroine!

upcoming_games.name: apochess
upcoming_games.description: Apochess is a progressive chess MMO game. Long-term progression. Very well balanced Chess RPG.

upcoming_games.name: Pharaoh's Secrets
upcoming_games.description: Explore Ancient Egypt in search of its lost treasures. A relaxing low poly 3D spot-the-difference game set across beautiful, hand-crafted scenes.

upcoming_games.name: Snotty's Sewer Reflushed
upcoming_games.description: Enter the sewer one more time! Snotty's Sewer Reflushed is the remake of the indie horror where survival is key, and buttons must be pressed.

upcoming_games.name: Castle Cab
upcoming_games.description: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

upcoming_games.name: Iona's Island
upcoming_games.description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders to help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape the world accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

upcoming_games.name: Peace & Quiet
upcoming_games.description: In this RPG, you control a person who is trapped in an unknown place and is trying to learn about their past. Now you must find a way out… or remain trapped forever.

upcoming_games.name: Temporal Distortion
upcoming_games.description: Triple Triad on a hex board, at a lamplit table. Place a pebble, then turn it to strike: the higher number takes the lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Eight Distortion cards, four worlds, and a stranger across the table who knows whose story this is.

upcoming_games.name: Animal Zone
upcoming_games.description: Animal zone is a fast and furious one-shot one-kill 2D shooter game. Make headshots, tear your opponents to pieces, and stay alive to take your place in the food chain! Face off against your friends and other players in this brutal animal world.

upcoming_games.name: The Hidden Index
upcoming_games.description: Investigue os recantos mais profundos da dark web neste jogo de terror psicológico e mistério. Analise arquivos, decifre terminais e desvenda segredos perturbadores numa atmosfera tensa e imersiva. Cada clique aproxima-o do desconhecido.

upcoming_games.name: WhoKilledKK
upcoming_games.description: This is a first-person horror adventure game where you enter the mansion of Kun Kun, the richest man in Aikun City. Everything inside has been eerily controlled. Kun Kun has set up a series of puzzles to stop intruders. Can you solve these puzzles and escape Kun Kun's mansion?

upcoming_games.name: Terrified Gorillas
upcoming_games.description: A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

upcoming_games.name: Veltarum
upcoming_games.description: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

upcoming_games.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
upcoming_games.description: A tower defense game with team building and online co-op. Recruit heroes, combine synergies, forge equipment and choose Heavenly Gifts. Manage resources between waves, counter invisible and flying enemies, and defend the crossing between two realms, solo or with friends.

upcoming_games.name: The Guiding Light
upcoming_games.description: The Guiding Light is a single-player action RPG with pixel heroes and a 3D fantasy world. Choose Warrior, Mage, Tank, Archer, or Swordsman; master unique skills, explore villages and dungeons, and defeat foes and bosses. Find your fighting style, grow stronger, and light the way home.

upcoming_games.name: Project Babel
upcoming_games.description: Create maps and compose your own music, weaving melody and rhythm into falling-block puzzles. Share your challenges and compete on global leaderboards in a roguelite with typing, rune combos and strategic builds. Choose Oaths, raise the Heat and adapt as sanity shifts.

upcoming_games.name: 阿飛 AFEI
upcoming_games.description: A fruit fly in a glass box on a windowsill. A small, slow game: place fruit, tap the glass and watch it walk, eat and take off, across 20 tasks. Its brain is a simplified model built from the published wiring map of a fly's central nervous system. All movements are assisted by code.

upcoming_games.name: Softfall
upcoming_games.description: A cozy winter MOBA on a snowy mountain. Two teams of five fight to chase the other team's eagle off the mountain. Quick matches, Easy to learn, and best with friends. The basics come down to: chopping down trees, fishing, and even hiding in the snow.

upcoming_games.name: Crash Relay
upcoming_games.description: Up to 10 players. Two players per car. Share the controls, grab weapons and powers, and sabotage rival teams in Crash Relay, a chaotic multiplayer racing game where teamwork is the key to reaching the finish line.

upcoming_games.name: BRAINFREEZE
upcoming_games.description: A first-person ice cream roguelike. Serve the line, hit the quota, and hand every cent to a boss who is very clear about what happens if you come up short. Draft cards between shifts to build a run that survives one more day. The truck is locked. The phone is ringing. Get scooping.

upcoming_games.name: 2in1
upcoming_games.description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

upcoming_games.name: PeeVPee
upcoming_games.description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

upcoming_games.name: Deep Digger
upcoming_games.description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

upcoming_games.name: When Life Gives You Lemons
upcoming_games.description: Run a lemonade stand with or against 3 of your friends! Cooperate or sabotage each other while you, mix ingredients, craft the perfect recipe, squeeze fresh juice, and keep your customers happy. Order fruits and equipment, unlock upgrades and grow your stand into the ultimate business empire.

upcoming_games.name: SUSPECIES
upcoming_games.description: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

upcoming_games.name: La Agencia del Riel
upcoming_games.description: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.

upcoming_games.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
upcoming_games.description: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

upcoming_games.name: 12 Board Games
upcoming_games.description: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.

upcoming_games.name: FISH OS
upcoming_games.description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

upcoming_games.name: Project: Haste
upcoming_games.description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

upcoming_games.name: Hidden Bananas
upcoming_games.description: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all? 🍌🏝️

upcoming_games.name: My Child New Beginnings
upcoming_games.description: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

upcoming_games.name: Vending Machine Simulator
upcoming_games.description: A first-person business sim about keeping a growing network of vending machines profitable. Start with $4,000, a tired van and one snack machine, then drive around Millbrook restocking, repairing and haggling over leases. Up to four players can share one company over a LAN.

upcoming_games.name: No One Runs Alone
upcoming_games.description: No One Runs Alone is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where you and your team are bound together by the Soulbinder. Outsmart the Hunter, grab powerful perks, adapt to wild game modes, and make every escape a hilarious fight for survival.

upcoming_games.name: 神话大乱斗
upcoming_games.description: MythBrawl is an ink-wash dark fantasy roguelike deck-builder rooted in Chinese mythology. Choose 1 of 5 classes - Sword, Martial, Bow, Magic or Talisman - forge a deck from 1200+ cards, and battle 125 mythical monsters across 5 realms to end the twilight of the gods!

upcoming_games.name: Aveos
upcoming_games.description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

upcoming_games.name: Black Hole Surfers
upcoming_games.description: Trapped after being sucked into a black hole, your only hope is to gather resources from the passing debris, upgrade your ship and survive long enough to find a way to escape. A unique blend of bullet-heaven action and incremental upgrading, will you find your way back home in Black Hole Surfers?

upcoming_games.name: Roll of Chaos
upcoming_games.description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

upcoming_games.name: Pick The Suspect
upcoming_games.description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

upcoming_games.name: Spektr
upcoming_games.description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

upcoming_games.name: Far Company
upcoming_games.description: Crew a starship with up to three friends. Fly its fighters, man its guns, board enemy ships and rob them blind, and carry each other home. Or throw each other out of the hangar. Friendly fire is on. The feed remembers who did it.

upcoming_games.name: Bust Out
upcoming_games.description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

upcoming_games.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
upcoming_games.description: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

upcoming_games.name: Compactor Baron
upcoming_games.description: Point and the hammer swings in this active incremental. Crush cans, toasters and safes into cubes, pay bills that grow as you earn, and build a bench of machines and a helper robot that work right alongside you.

upcoming_games.name: Bush League Baseball
upcoming_games.description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, nine ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, race go-karts between innings and play for the World Series. One or two players.

upcoming_games.name: ESCAPE SHOW
upcoming_games.description: A first-person game show: you and your friends are locked in identical rooms and only the master knows the way out — and the master can't speak. Read the mime and the giant board, turn the room upside down, raid another room through the tube and escape before the gas.

upcoming_games.name: 奇怪的三国模拟器
upcoming_games.description: This is an AI-driven story-driven strategy card RPG. In "Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator", you are not a spectator you are the one who rewrites the script. The Peach Garden Oath may not come to fruition, but if it fails to materialize, the course of the Three Kingdoms will be completely rewritten.

upcoming_games.name: ciaocargo
upcoming_games.description: Master the art of truck driving in this minimalist 2D top-down physics simulator set in Italy. Navigate tight Mediterranean streets and perfect your parking geometry. Relax in the stress-free Zen mode, or push your precision driving skills to the absolute limit in Time Attack.

upcoming_games.name: ONE MORE TERM
upcoming_games.description: Lead a republic through 48 months. Examine documents, manage your cabinet, pass laws, survive crises, and answer for the consequences of every political compromise.

upcoming_games.name: Build the Hole
upcoming_games.description: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

upcoming_games.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
upcoming_games.description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

upcoming_games.name: Manifest Moonfall 月球坠落
upcoming_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder adapted from "Records of the Giant Moon." Master the unique Emotion system with five distinct characters to break the death loop.

upcoming_games.name: The Curator
upcoming_games.description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

upcoming_games.name: CRYMELIGHT
upcoming_games.description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

upcoming_games.name: AI Clicker
upcoming_games.description: Click Your Way to World Domination (Or Doom)! Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter… or creates a future where AI replaces you!

upcoming_games.name: VOID SOAR
upcoming_games.description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

upcoming_games.name: Cutie Office
upcoming_games.description: What if your PC were a tiny pixel company? Every CPU core types away at a desk, every program you open clocks in for work, and the office cat naps when things are quiet. A cozy desktop companion that turns your computer's real activity into a living office.

upcoming_games.name: Somewhere, Together
upcoming_games.description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

upcoming_games.name: Jet Combat Sim
upcoming_games.description: A low-altitude jet combat game. Fly mouse-aim jets based on the real aircraft's public technical data over an endless procedural world, score low passes and streaks, break through SAM belts and enemy fighters to the core, and climb a ladder of 38 aircraft from the MiG-15 to the F-35.

upcoming_games.name: Gnome Miners
upcoming_games.description: Drill, sell, dig deeper: online co-op mining for up to 8 players. Raid procedural caves, build your own guns, climb into a mech and hunt a fire-breathing boss at the bottom of the pit. Just one more drill. Hats are mandatory.

upcoming_games.name: Find The Clover
upcoming_games.description: Search a vast clover meadow for 50 rare specimens. Harvest by hand, upgrade to tools and garden machines, carry your crop to the buyer, and pour it out yourself. Bring special finds to your display cabinet.

upcoming_games.name: Repair Guru
upcoming_games.description: Every fault is real. Run a 1970s electronics repair shop where nothing is scripted: switch the machine on, let it warm up and measure your way to the one part that has failed. Fix it right and get paid; fix it wrong and it comes back. Twenty-six machines, 517 faults.

upcoming_games.name: Main Bastion
upcoming_games.description: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

upcoming_games.name: Break the Piñatas
upcoming_games.description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

upcoming_games.name: Frostbeaks
upcoming_games.description: Outrun the avalanche. You are a penguin in a bobble hat carving down an endless procedural mountain — five biomes, seven weather states, six power-ups, and a wall of snow that never stops. Race up to ten players online, or chase your own line solo.

upcoming_games.name: PLOW
upcoming_games.description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

upcoming_games.name: GhostLine - Origin Zero
upcoming_games.description: Breach the networks of Helix Dynamics in a cyberpunk routing puzzle. Recalibrate modules, inject pulses, and outsmart Firewalls, viruses, and ICE as GHOST uncovers a conspiracy that can erase people from records—and from their own memories.

upcoming_games.name: Saddlebow
upcoming_games.description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

upcoming_games.name: WHO CHANGED IT?
upcoming_games.description: Keep your eyes open and find the anomalies! "WHO CHANGED IT?" is a next-gen online anomaly game for 1-8 players. But there's a catch: the anomaly creator is one of you! Objects can move, disappear, or duplicate. Snap photos of anomalies in different game modes and beat your opponents!

upcoming_games.name: Fly Chicken Fly
upcoming_games.description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

upcoming_games.name: Wonderful Time
upcoming_games.description: Control time to manipulate the movement of objects in this third-person puzzle game. Use the flow of time to reach places that were once inaccessible. The reward you seek awaits you.

upcoming_games.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
upcoming_games.description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

upcoming_games.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
upcoming_games.description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

upcoming_games.name: Spark of Tales
upcoming_games.description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

upcoming_games.name: Kachow Kart Racing
upcoming_games.description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

upcoming_games.name: Hardcoded
upcoming_games.description: A surreal 2D action-adventure platformer about a self-aware AI. Travel through unstable games, overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and adapt to the Creator’s interference.

upcoming_games.name: Rhythm Roll
upcoming_games.description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

upcoming_games.name: Dave's House
upcoming_games.description: In this frantic first-person co-op horror, answer the phone before Grandma eats you! Cook the food exactly as ordered, or she’ll eat you! Throw the food on the table and hide—don’t let it fall, or she'll eat you! If she finds you, RUN! If she catches you... don't get eaten!

upcoming_games.name: Radiant Starlets
upcoming_games.description: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

upcoming_games.name: Bridgelands
upcoming_games.description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

upcoming_games.name: Code of Shadows
upcoming_games.description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

upcoming_games.name: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
upcoming_games.description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

upcoming_games.name: He's Kevin
upcoming_games.description: He's Kevin is a chaotic online arena brawler for up to 4 players. Drop bombs, knock them back with a bat, pull them with a magnet and teleport out of trouble. Bring your friends. Kevin needs someone to blame.

upcoming_games.name: Reshine TCG Cards: Cozy Restoration
upcoming_games.description: Dusty, taped and bent trading cards arrive in customer parcels. Unbox them, wipe, spray, peel and press each card back to a mint shine in your sunny little workshop, then sleeve it and send it home. No timers, no penalties, just satisfying restoration.

upcoming_games.name: Fishpals
upcoming_games.description: Fishpals is a cozy multiplayer fishing adventure. Explore colorful worlds with up to 16 players at once, including friends. Reel in unusual catches, hatch companion pals, decorate your home, and take on party dungeons with up to 4 players. Cast a line and unwind.

upcoming_games.name: GARITO
upcoming_games.description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

upcoming_games.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
upcoming_games.description: is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

upcoming_games.name: Sudoku Nook
upcoming_games.description: Sudoku Nook is a cozy, hand-drawn focused game. INFINITE, random generated sudoku boards based on difficulty with global leaderboards!

upcoming_games.name: The Queens
upcoming_games.description: The Queens is a fast-paced party game for 2–4 players who take turns playing cards and race to slap the pile first when they spot a match. Overcome challenges, avoid wrong moves, and grab the final card to become the queen of the table!

upcoming_games.name: Back to the Pussy - Season 1
upcoming_games.description: After the death of his inventor Grandpa, Ksy gets a chance to fix the mistakes of his past, and a chance to fuck all the girls he couldn't back in the day! This is a funny, daring, and unabashedly sexy story about a complete loser getting his hands on a time machine and utilizing its full potential.

upcoming_games.name: 10 calls
upcoming_games.description: Death has crashed the office Halloween party, scythe in hand and pumpkin on its head! Fight back, wreck the office, or haunt your colleagues as a ghost. Play as Death and unleash hell. To escape, just answer the phone. Preferably before you’re sliced in half.

upcoming_games.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
upcoming_games.description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

upcoming_games.name: Six Coins
upcoming_games.description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

upcoming_games.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
upcoming_games.description: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

upcoming_games.name: Dead Last
upcoming_games.description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

upcoming_games.name: Star Imperium
upcoming_games.description: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

upcoming_games.name: Phoning It In
upcoming_games.description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

upcoming_games.name: Music Maniaz
upcoming_games.description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

upcoming_games.name: Underpaid
upcoming_games.description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

upcoming_games.name: SIFT
upcoming_games.description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

upcoming_games.name: The Last Day: What Remains
upcoming_games.description: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

upcoming_games.name: Game World
upcoming_games.description: Game World is a cozy game store sorting simulation. Pick up games, consoles, controllers, and accessories that are scattered throughout the video game store. Organize the chaos, find where everything belongs, and restore the shop. No time limits, no pressure, just relax and sort.

upcoming_games.name: Friends Park
upcoming_games.description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

upcoming_games.name: Road to FIRE
upcoming_games.description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

upcoming_games.name: Motor Havoc
upcoming_games.description: Arcade combat racing for people who see a finish line and think, why not ram someone instead. Weapons, explosions, and chaos guaranteed, whether you're racing solo or dragging friends into it with you.

upcoming_games.name: HardLuck
upcoming_games.description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

upcoming_games.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
upcoming_games.description: A turn-based RPG about eating lots of cakes, hanging out with your friends, writing haikus, hearing tons of dad jokes, and exploring a world full of unique characters. It's also about surviving child abuse, dealing with your crazy, mentally-ill mother, and dealing with the fact that nothing lasts.

upcoming_games.name: ArcanoPlay
upcoming_games.description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

release_games.name: Clara Wraiths 3
release_games.description: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

release_games.name: A Thousand Stamps
release_games.description: Collect, sort, and organize hundreds of unique stamps across beautiful themed albums. Play alone or online with friends, create your own collections from photos, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting everything in its place.

release_games.name: Find The ZTA VI CD
release_games.description: With your team of 4, there are no rules in this chaotic battle: Don't fall for fake CDs, throw objects at your opponents, and defeat them at any cost. The first to find the real CD and reach the police wins. It's time to put your friendship to the test! The real ZTA VI CD will be in your hands!

release_games.name: Space Golf - A golf game in space...
release_games.description: Golf among the planets. Every planet pulls your ball: bend shots around moons, ride solar winds, slingshot past pulsars and land on tiny worlds. 12 courses, 216 holes, 4 clubs and a lots of ball styles — alone or with your friends.

release_games.name: Cave Alchemist
release_games.description: A wizard cat digs into caves where every pixel is simulated. Lava turns water to steam, acid eats stone, oil burns, crates tumble and bombs blow the world apart. Build spell wands, pick perks, beat bosses and find the portal down - one paw at a time.

release_games.name: Bank Vault: Tidy Up Together
release_games.description: Organize a bank vault packed with 2,345 unique items! Sort cash, gold, and precious treasures, arrange every shelf, and turn chaos into order. Team up with friends in this satisfying tidying adventure!

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Fire
release_games.description: Turn up the heat in Hentai Femboy Fire! Meet fiery femboys, solve exciting puzzles, and unlock sizzling artwork. Every completed challenge brings a new spark of temptation.

release_games.name: Hentai Milf Desire
release_games.description: Some desires are impossible to resist! Hentai Milf Desire invites you to solve captivating puzzles, admire gorgeous mature women, and unlock alluring artwork filled with passion and charm.

release_games.name: Spaceship Wars Together
release_games.description: Strap into a fully 3D starfighter and battle endless alien waves with up to 3 friends. Stack roguelite upgrades, chain class combos, fire your ultimate beam and bring down 11 colossal bosses - or turn your guns on each other in PvP dogfights.

release_games.name: Work From Dungeon
release_games.description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

release_games.name: ZX Allstar Holdem
release_games.description: A Hold'em table in a secret members-only club. Tonight again, beauties with hidden reasons sit down to bet. To the one who loses it all, you offer not pity but a deal. Break them, make an offer hard to refuse, and claim their secret 'reward.' At the table's end waits a dealer sure she can't lose.

release_games.name: Spin It Lupin!
release_games.description: Rotate four gems to form a matching 2×2 square! Clear all connected gems of the same color and trigger chain reactions as new gems fall. Enjoy 100 stages, high-score challenges, and local two-player versus and co-op modes.

release_games.name: Puzzlozenge
release_games.description: Rotate groups of three diamond-shaped tiles to restore the illusion of a colorful cube. Choose from eight puzzle sizes, ranging from 12 to 243 tiles, and race against the clock to beat your personal best. Simple rules, precise controls, endless challenges.

release_games.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
release_games.description: Run a cozy potion shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Brew potions, stock your shelves, set your prices and serve adventurers who shop with their own purses. Secretly raise monsters in the cellar, pay the corridor its toll in gold and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it.

release_games.name: Strip Memory: Naughty Cowgirls
release_games.description: Strip Memory Naughty Cowgirls is an addictive adult memory card game set in the Wild West. Challenge four stunning cowgirls with unique personalities, test your focus, and unlock high-definition animated rewards and spicy scenes in the gallery.

release_games.name: Frog Collector
release_games.description: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

release_games.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike
release_games.description: A physics-based roguelike where you pull back a marble, let go, and score every time it bounces off a wall. Combine Patches to activate multiple Synergies, upgrade them and collect Relics to make a build of your own, then climb past rule-bending bosses to the final boss.

release_games.name: Trolley Together
release_games.description: Five citizens on one track, the president on the other, and your friend is screaming at you to pull the lever. Trains don't stop coming. Run between the switches, fight over who gets hit, shove whoever's blocking the lever — with your fists or with a train.

release_games.name: Let Me Die
release_games.description: You're trapped by a monster! Hit it, farm coins, buy upgrades, watch numbers go up. Until you're strong enough to escape.

release_games.name: Oh Shear!
release_games.description: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

release_games.name: Form
release_games.description: Feed, observe, and raise FORM, a mysterious digital entity living on the RÆLOS desktop. In this atmospheric idle simulation, time passes even while you are away. Explore files, complete quests, play minigames, and decipher the traces left by every cycle.

release_games.name: RoadKill Rally 2
release_games.description: A darkly comic top-down driving game about being forced behind the wheel in the middle of a crowded pedestrian district. Drive carefully or embrace the chaos. Either way, your only reward is freedom.

release_games.name: Femboy Futa Cafe
release_games.description: You inherit a cafe with two faces: a third-wave coffee bar by day, and after midnight, the city's quietest sanctuary for its femboy and futa regulars. You have 45 days to save it from the chain that wants it gone — and six people who make it worth saving.

release_games.name: Warchaic
release_games.description: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

release_games.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
release_games.description: Scrub a filthy disco ball and earn $ 1,000,000 by spinning it! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

release_games.name: Thoth's Riddle
release_games.description: Can you escape the Pyramid of Thoth? You have been tasked to explore the Pyramid and uncover its secrets. But you have fallen into the chamber and now must escape this mysterious Pyramid by solving 7 uniquely themed puzzles.

release_games.name: Roadkill
release_games.description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

release_games.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
release_games.description: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

release_games.name: Squircle
release_games.description: It goes in the square hole! Squircle is neon pinball meets crazy golf, and it's super cool (just trust me, okay). Fire glowing shapes, bounce them off everything and sink each one into its matching hole. Simple, right? Right up until there are six of them.

release_games.name: Swarmbreaker
release_games.description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

release_games.name: Alien Skies
release_games.description: Blast through the cosmos in Alien Skies, a neo-classical side-scrolling space shooter! Pilot your starship across diverse alien worlds, unleash devastating weapon upgrades, and upgrade your ship to conquer an ever-growing alien threat.

release_games.name: Freeze Line
release_games.description: Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower — no memory, a warm pocket watch, and your master's charge: gather time's scattered shards and mend the world. Freeze time, aim your dash, slip past all that wants you dead — then return to the one who sent you, and a truth that rewrites everything.

release_games.name: Stash Mayhem
release_games.description: Run a medieval-fantasy warehouse in this roguelike for 1 to 4 players online. Sort the goods your way while it's calm, survive the rush of impatient customers and upgrade your warehouse every night. The only map is in your head. Know where everything is, or just embrace the mayhem.

release_games.name: Next Acre
release_games.description: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

release_games.name: Three Kingdoms: Cao Cao's Chastity Defense
release_games.description: Cao Cao journeys across the realm, pursued by countless beauties eager to have their way with him. But he has eyes only for the married beauties of the Three Kingdoms... Play as Cao Cao in this absurd yet strangely logical adult game of romancing married women × defending his chastity.

release_games.name: Onward! Autobattles
release_games.description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onward! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

release_games.name: 树人：中国班主任
release_games.description: “十年树木，百年树人” 《树人》是一部班主任视角的视觉小说。三年时光，12 名学生，8 条交错的故事线，和一门真实可学的高中数学课——12 小时以上的流程里，你不只是看完这个故事，你还要带着他们走完高考。 有些事会在开学第一周就摆在你面前，有些要到最后一页才明白：他们的人生，从来不是一道有标准答案的题。

release_games.name: Tiny Dwellings
release_games.description: From the creators of Moonfrost, Tiny Dwellings is a whimsical hand-drawn spin-off builder with kindred pixelly vibes! Delight in designing your dream petite homesteads and charming dioramas. Unwind in a stress-free haven and dig the heartwarming lo-fi ambiences as you express your creative muse.

release_games.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
release_games.description: Disguise yourself as little demons on a pilgrimage West to become Buddha! A cozy, hand-drawn party-based RPG with auto-battle, so you can easily fight, upgrade, and clear trials with a cast of funny misfit monsters.

release_games.name: Crackheads
release_games.description: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.

release_games.name: Space Tenacity
release_games.description: Chuck space aliens into each other! Dodge giant asteroids! Engage your tractor beam, force field and phase shifting technology to navigate the unknown in this 2D side scrolling physics based space adventure.

release_games.name: wozitdev's 3D Sniper
release_games.description: Explore procedurally generated cities in wozitdev's take on Spector's adage of the perfect, block Imm-Sim, from behind the scope. In this fully 3-Dimensional immersive simulation sandbox you star as the titular Sniper. Drop in, roam the blocks, do as you will and take on the mantle of your namesake.

release_games.name: Above Par
release_games.description: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

release_games.name: Blind Phobia
release_games.description: You are blind and trapped in an infinite hospital corridor. Use your guide cane and other senses to detect anomalies, question illusions, and find a way out.

release_games.name: LevelFighters
release_games.description: Face your enemy. How? BY CREATING PLATFORMING LEVELS! Build a level in 5 minutes, beat your own level to set a record, and then take on your enemy's level while trying to beat their record.

release_games.name: Leash Kid
release_games.description: A physics based chaos game starring Leash Kid! a tiny terror with big plans and a very short leash. Smash products, topple bystanders, and wreck the store, before Mom drags you out screaming.

release_games.name: Cloud Getaway
release_games.description: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!

release_games.name: ELEMENTAIL
release_games.description: Draw it, Store it, Strike hard! A charming casual deckbuilding roguelike with magical animal wizards! Strategically combine elemental cards—Water, Fire, and Lightning—and collect over 150 unique relics to build your deck, customize your playstyle, and save a world tainted by elemental corruption.

release_games.name: Shoot'em & Scoot'em
release_games.description: Aliens stole your horse! Saddle up, take aim, and blast across space! Every shot rockets you the opposite way and you can change directions on a dime. Can you rescue Scooty?

release_games.name: Light the Void
release_games.description: Light the Void is a pixel-art incremental exploration game. Reveal a mysterious world one tile at a time, gather resources, restore ancient structures, and unlock powerful upgrades. Grow your void world, overcome colossal titans, and bring light.

release_games.name: Cabbie Chaos
release_games.description: An over-the-top arcade taxi game for 1–8 players, set in a crazy world full of nonsense! Grab a passenger and get them to their destination by any means necessary — over ramps, through parks, across frozen lakes and down into the sewers. Drive fast, drive crazy, and get paid for it!

release_games.name: Breachwall: Network Defense
release_games.description: Defend a growing network against real-world cyberattacks - from a freelancer's home laptop to the quantum era. Place firewalls and 2FA, research new defenses, catch phishing emails, read the logs and decide what to save when everything is under attack.

release_games.name: 앨로이스 택틱스(ALOES Tactics)
release_games.description: A midcentury fantasy auto-battle roguelike strategy game.

release_games.name: Iron & Instinct
release_games.description: Raid dungeons, collect monster eggs, and hatch your own army. As the Break Knight, raise your monsters on the ranch, pick your strongest for your party, and fight side by side through ever more dangerous dungeons in this 2D monster-raising RPG.

release_games.name: Marbles: Tidy Up
release_games.description: Turn colorful chaos into satisfying order. Collect 1,800 marbles, sort them into matching jars, and unlock handy upgrades. A cozy little game to enjoy at your own pace...

release_games.name: Umami
release_games.description: Build a menu of real dishes and challenge animal chefs in a culinary strategy card game. Compare four tastes, risk random replacements, and use regional spices that affect both sides. Travel across six countries and discover traditional recipes.

release_games.name: Demon Castle Guard
release_games.description: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.

release_games.name: Grave Ambition
release_games.description: They used the Overlord as a training dummy. Bad idea... In this casual voxel incremental action-RPG, every recruit you smash leaves a stat in your bones. Grind, evolve into new undead forms and climb seven floors to the five heroes who put you there.

release_games.name: SonaCraft – Instrument Repair
release_games.description: Take over your great-aunt's old workshop and repair real instruments. Find the fault by ear, take a trumpet, guitar or snare drum apart in 3D, replace worn parts, tune and adjust – until it passes the sound test.

release_games.name: Mini Legends Idle
release_games.description: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!

release_games.name: Rip It Together
release_games.description: Bid on mystery packages, then rip, pop, squish and smash through ridiculous layers of wrapping with up to 3 friends. Gift paper, slime, balloons, chains, giant eggs… and inside? A supercar. Or a poo. A silly co-op unwrapping party.

release_games.name: No Sleep Tonight
release_games.description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

release_games.name: Elf World Adventure 14
release_games.description: Elf World Adventure 14 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

release_games.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!
release_games.description: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!

release_games.name: Cinderpeak
release_games.description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

release_games.name: Sort Memes Together
release_games.description: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

release_games.name: Spring Breeze Shokudo
release_games.description: 1978, southern Taiwan. Come home to reopen your grandmother's shuttered shokudo: shop the morning market, set the menu, hire staff and win the street back from the flashy restaurant across the road. Now in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

release_games.name: Dreamspire 2
release_games.description: Return to a magical fantasy world in Dreamspire 2! Complete relaxing puzzles, meet beautiful fantasy heroines, and unlock a collection of explicit 18+ illustrations.

release_games.name: Benidorm Cruiser Order
release_games.description: Restore order to a cruise ship off Benidorm. Pick up 4,300 products, complete 64 objectives across 16 shops and solve preparation tasks. Upgrade your abilities, discover hidden souvenirs and play at your own pace in this single-player organizing game.

release_games.name: Underbloom
release_games.description: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

release_games.name: Adverse Reaction
release_games.description: Malpractice never looked this fun. A falling-pill puzzle roguelike where you cure patients, climb a 10-floor hospital, and build runs from 32 prescriptions, five flawed doctors, and no clean bill of health.

release_games.name: Hoppernaut
release_games.description: A rabbit, a jetpack and a lot of holes to dig. Collect every capsule, trap the robots, and hop from the launch pad to a black hole and up the Ascent across 37 levels. Three stars per level, ten time-trial sprints, a level editor. Old-school arcade platforming with a modern spring in its step.

release_games.name: Cable Management Simulator
release_games.description: Cable Management Sim is a chill organizing game where you install cables to provide internet for a building. Plan, trace, measure and cut your cables for the perfect install. learn abilities, unlock mini games, customisation and build out your server room in a no pressure no rush environment.

release_games.name: Help, My Capybaras Escaped!
release_games.description: Help, My Capybaras Escaped is a casual and fun hidden object game where you have to rescue all the capybaras in various colourful images!

release_games.name: Corporate Corp Incorporated
release_games.description: Survive the workday in a satirical first-person workplace life sim. Handle call queues, manage stress, take suspiciously necessary breaks, upgrade your desk, endure fake corporate software, and climb the ladder one absurd title at a time.

release_games.name: Collabulator
release_games.description: Collaborative Calculation has never been easier! Streamlined functionality meets masterful efficiency in the world’s FIRST and ONLY multi-user calculator. Now with Achievements!

release_games.name: Bomb Them Ores
release_games.description: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!

release_games.name: Attkand
release_games.description: ÅTTKAND is a minimalist color puzzle. Tap a chip to see the reaction wave around the board. Use the special chips to change the waves. Turn all the chips to the same color to win.

release_games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
release_games.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

release_games.name: Arbeitszeitbetrug - Das Spiel
release_games.description: Hattest du bei der Arbeit schon mal dieses "Boah, gar keine Lust"-Gefühl? Wenn ja, dann ist dieses Spiel für dich. Denn während du auf der Arbeit natürlich... arbeitest (...oder?), darfst du hier nach allen Regeln der Kunst Arbeitszeitbetrug begehen.

release_games.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
release_games.description: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

release_games.name: Swarmdle
release_games.description: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, collect weapons and upgrades, and unlock permanent upgrades between runs. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that is identical for every player in the world.

release_games.name: Pill & Chill
release_games.description: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no pressure, and lots of satisfying little sounds.

release_games.name: Tankii
release_games.description: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

release_games.name: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room
release_games.description: 1895. In this first-person escape room, you play as Dr. Voss's aspiring scientific heir. Explore an immersive Victorian laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles woven into the environment and the story, and unravel the dark secret behind Voss's experiments.

release_games.name: Espetero Simulator
release_games.description: Become the king of the grill in the world's first espeto simulator! Master the art of skewering sardines, control the fire on the beach, and manage the lunchtime rush at a beach bar in the middle of August. Can you handle the heat, or will your business go up in smoke?

release_games.name: Hentai Academy: UNDERTOW
release_games.description: An 18+ visual novel about a shipwreck that tore her away from everything she knew — and a forgotten island whose secrets have waited for years, buried deep in the jungle.

release_games.name: Elf World Adventure 13
release_games.description: Elf World Adventure 13 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

release_games.name: Circuit Keep
release_games.description: Your towers don't stop anything. Enemies walk straight over them. The only thing that turns them aside is a wall, so you build the maze yourself. Then the intrusions start fighting back. PHASE slides through your walls. HOPPER vaults over them. BREAKER eats them. You built the maze. Now defend it.

release_games.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
release_games.description: Run a cozy second-hand magic shop: buy suspicious junk, study ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, and haggle with eccentric customers who pay premium prices for magical nonsense.

release_games.name: Tuggin It
release_games.description: Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can! Unlock and purchase upgrades to make tuggin it go a little smoother, and apply cosmetics so you're always tuggin it with style!

release_games.name: Picky Numbers
release_games.description: Picky Numbers is a game based on lottery mechanics. Buy tickets, choose numbers, and watch as the drum draws results one by one. The more numbers you hit, the bigger the payout. Each ticket is a different strategy, with higher risk and higher reward, or a JACKPOT.

release_games.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
release_games.description: Bounce On is back! Roll and bounce your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress. Dozens of challenging platform levels to explore to find all the secrets.

release_games.name: Rocket.io
release_games.description: is an online multiplayer arena game where hover-cars battle for territory. Leave a trail, claim ground, and cut off your rivals! Play quick matches, private rooms, and battles with 2 to 8 teams, or take on the AI. Collect and customize over 25 vehicles.

release_games.name: Linkominoes
release_games.description: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game where overlapping squares form connected structures. Unwind with the satisfaction of placing pieces and building patterns, or take on unique challenges that put spatial planning and strategy to the test.

release_games.name: Deep Space Miner
release_games.description: Mine alien ore, build specialized drones, process resources, discover new worlds, defeat giant ore bosses, and prestige for permanent upgrades in this incremental mining game.

release_games.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
release_games.description: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

release_games.name: Patience Is Key
release_games.description: Patience Is Key is a classic challenging 2D platformer game in which you will encounter difficult and tricky levels that will test your patience as the title suggests, and make you think about better solutions on passing the levels.

release_games.name: CRUSHCHOP
release_games.description: From a hidden bastard son to the Lord of Sunlit City! Rebuild a burned realm through gambling in an arena of clashing warriors. You will gamble, rally soldiers, build castles, mine resources, raid giants, and do it all in CRUSHCHOP!

release_games.name: Wisp & Willow
release_games.description: Use cards to build a garden in this cozy puzzle game. Each level has a different deck. Each card has different interactions with other cards. Discover them and decide what kind of garden you want to build for yourself.

release_games.name: Last convoy
release_games.description: A survivors-like auto-shooter where the hero is an armored convoy. Grow it car by car, take a crew on board and mow down hordes of thousands of enemies. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

release_games.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
release_games.description: A fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

release_games.name: Shades of Fear - North Loop
release_games.description: Shades of Fear - North Loop is a first-person psychological horror game inspired by a true story. In October 2004, four old friends plan a weekend of camping on a trail they've known since they were kids. Not everyone on the trail is there to camp.

release_games.name: Hero Of The Guitar
release_games.description: In this *Seraph's Last Stand*-inspired roguelike, you play as a guitarist without a band who must eliminate other musical instruments—with the piano serving as the boss—while collecting upgrades and abilities to face increasingly powerful enemies.

release_games.name: Death & Deadlines
release_games.description: A darkly comic puzzle game about climbing Hell’s corporate ladder. You’re dead, back at a desk, and determined to work your way to the top—even if every demon in the building needs to be “let go.”

release_games.name: KORRIDOR
release_games.description: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

release_games.name: Crack In The Dark
release_games.description: Crack in the Dark is a cave exploration game where you use sound to see. Draw your own maps to avoid getting lost in sprawling cave systems, and rely on your whip for combat, movement, and navigation.

release_games.name: CardCraft Champions
release_games.description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

release_games.name: Math Time
release_games.description: 45 seconds, 15 questions, one rival. Math Time is a fast 1v1 math duel: race real players or quirky math machines, pick the right answer from three choices and climb the leagues. Plus a Daily Challenge, Sudden Death, Blitz and Practice.

release_games.name: Block Garden
release_games.description: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

release_games.name: Find100Buttons
release_games.description: Find100Buttons is a first-person 3D adventure game where your goal is to find 100 hidden buttons. Explore the world, search every corner, discover secrets, and prepare for unexpected surprises along the way!

release_games.name: Three Kingdoms: Survivors
release_games.description: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

release_games.name: Clean vs. Dirty!
release_games.description: The germs are attacking! Grab your broom, conquer 30 progressively challenging levels, buy and upgrade cleaning tools, and face the endless wrath of Endless Mode! Every tool has unique perks, range, damage, and attack speed. Can you keep the bathroom clean?

release_games.name: PURLOIN
release_games.description: Steal cube-shaped materials and blueprints from dark, monster-guarded islands, then bring them home to build a well-lit island in cozy co-op horror. Stack, wobble and rebuild everything you take.

release_games.name: Cubetoria: Build. Think. Solve.
release_games.description: Fill the cube with no gaps. 100 hand-made 3D polycube challenges from the Cubetoria Series 1 puzzle book, from your first 2×2×2 to expert Pro builds. Turn, tilt and snap colourful pieces into place, find every answer, keep a daily streak and build your own puzzles.

release_games.name: Gramps & Whiskers
release_games.description: A grumpy old fisherman sits on your Windows taskbar and fishes while you work. His cat climbs your windows, naps on his lap and steals his catch. Dress them both up with hats and gear that grandpa fishes up along the way.

release_games.name: Who Framed The Cat?
release_games.description: A cozy cat detective set in an isometric seaside neighborhood. Mandarin, a ginger cat, has been framed by a look-alike. He has seven days to find the culprit and prove his innocence to people who only hear him say "meow."

release_games.name: Touhou Chess
release_games.description: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn in a 9-chapter story, sharpen your play with puzzles, and battle with spell cards or play friends online.

release_games.name: Stealing Christmas
release_games.description: Stealing Christmas is a hidden-object collection, loot and run game with no time limits. Sneak through decorated towns at night, swipe every ornament, gift, and lump of coal, then raid Santa's Workshop and steal his belongings to put an end to his naughty-or-nice operation!

release_games.name: Infinipop
release_games.description: A game about popping bubble sheets with your brain switched off. Except every rebirth gives you a new way to pop: drag, multi-pop, full-board shatter, one-hit crush. The faster you clear, the more the screen fills with effects. Ten materials, ten sounds. Twenty board shapes. Endless stages.

release_games.name: Banner Age
release_games.description: Banner Age is a real-time strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Build your army, advance through the ages, and strengthen your forces through the talent tree. Battle an online opponent or a bot, defend your banner, and destroy the enemy’s.

release_games.name: ROKUMENSHU
