release_games.description: An auto battler RPG where every hero is a six-sided die. Read the enemy's dice, set your formation, swap new faces onto your dice and weight them in your favor. Then take your hands off the keyboard and watch fate roll across three chapters of Japanese folklore.

release_games.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
release_games.description: A cozy first-person sorting game for one to four players. One big meadow, 1,400 mixed-up sheep, 18 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, and fill every pen solo or in online co-op.

release_games.name: Savebot: The Last Garden
release_games.description: A calm programming game. Write the programs of little robots, in blocks or in Python-like code, and teach them to bring five sleeping planets back to life. You never steer them: you teach them, then watch life come back on its own.

release_games.name: Code Market
release_games.description: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell, you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java or C# code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

release_games.name: Big Deck, Big Fun
release_games.description: Arrange your cards, end your turn, and watch your deck resolve. Build a single-player roguelike deck around hero skills, fuse cards into stronger forms, and choose your route through monsters, rewards, and bosses.

release_games.name: Mediotorum
release_games.description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

release_games.name: Shadow at Noon
release_games.description: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.

release_games.name: Zaz Tower
release_games.description: An incremental tower defense game: defend your tower against hordes attacking from every direction. Choose cards, combine powers, recruit heroes, and turn each defeat into permanent upgrades so you can return stronger.

release_games.name: The Scratcher
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the JACKPOT and stop before you go BUST. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

release_games.name: Can You Candle it?
release_games.description: Sort scattered candles, fill the shelves, and bring order to a cozy candlelit room. Unlock upgrades through a skill tree to arrange candles faster and watch the clutter disappear in this relaxing first person organizing game.

release_games.name: デスクトップフレンズ
release_games.description: A voice-chat companion who lives on your desktop. Talk with two childhood friends, cheeky Tsumugi and gentle Hiyori, who remember you, start conversations on their own, set timers and notes by voice, and keep you company while you work. Japanese only (voice, text and interface).

release_games.name: Peekour
release_games.description: Peekour is a 2D pixel art platformer. YOU desperately need to pee and only the final toilet counts! Run, jump and parkour through 6+ levels. Collect coins and bottles of water to get more pee, and customize your experience with 40+ skins.

release_games.name: Link Loop
release_games.description: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

release_games.name: MMO Guild Manager
release_games.description: MMO Guild Manager is a simulation game set in a fictional MMORPG, where your guild fights 5v5 match after match. Take a newly formed underdog guild to the top. Every loss has a reason. Figure it out, rebuild your team, and take down your rival.

release_games.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad
release_games.description: Sort thousands of tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades. Play Solo or Co-op.

release_games.name: AMIDA Q
release_games.description: AMIDA Q is a high-difficulty amidakuji (ladder lottery) puzzle game. Place pieces on the board and guide the balls from the left to their assigned lanes, in the assigned order. New gimmicks keep appearing as you progress, making the board ever more complex. A dynamic, dramatic amidakuji experience.

release_games.name: Tarot: Deck of Celestials
release_games.description: Step into the serene celestial sanctum of Tarot: Deck of Celestials. Draw from an authentic 78-card arcana imbued with cosmic lore, consult classic and custom spreads, record your journey in the persistent journal, and import custom decks to make the cosmos your own.

release_games.name: Pixel Cartographer
release_games.description: Pixel Cartographer is a cozy builder, where you're tasked with building out all the locations on the map! Each area has a unique biome, along with limitations to channel your creativity - but of course there's also a sandbox mode with limitless freedom!

release_games.name: Kyle Coral
release_games.description: A breathtaking cave-diving adventure where your air is the only clock. Read each new cave, find the air pockets, and reach the exit before your last breath. Five biomes, four guardians, and gear you keep. Out now. Dive in.

release_games.name: Don't Panic, Defend!
release_games.description: Enemies come in endless waves and your soldiers fight on their own. You spend the gold: pick races, buy troops, stack synergies. March across seven regions and beat seven Bosses. Lose and you only lose gold. Gear, Star Map and Talents stay.

release_games.name: Crime and Punishment
release_games.description: Dostoevsky’s complete, unabridged Russian text staged as a visual novel, with illustrated scenes and optional choices that preserve the original.

release_games.name: Muster & Magic
release_games.description: Recruit from more than 15 unit types, choose your Champion, and defend Coroaforte in a tactical defense game with roguelite progression. Combine units, plan your formation, and cast spells to stop the hordes. Between runs, unlock allies and chart your path through a branching skill tree.

release_games.name: Rookie Rook
release_games.description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

release_games.name: Meow Defense War
release_games.description: Newly appointed Meow Construction Manager, it's time to get to work! Can this thing you built withstand the mice's next shot? Build fortifications, glue materials, trick the mice. Protect the meow, chase high scores. The mice have bad eyesight, but the projectiles are real.

release_games.name: Drawmi: Twin Stick
release_games.description: An action-packed twin stick arena shooter where you can draw all of the enemies, players, weapons, and obstacles.

release_games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
release_games.description: A co-op INFINITE creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree. Grab new creatures from the Community Workshop to infinitely grow your collection and world.

release_games.name: Puzzles Are Better Together
release_games.description: Puzzles Are Better Together is a cozy 3D jigsaw escape you can enjoy solo or with friends in online co-op. Slow down, lose yourself in beautiful high-resolution artwork, and let calming music, satisfying piece placement, and shared moments turn every puzzle into time well spent.

release_games.name: Everhex
release_games.description: Build one tower. Hold endless waves. Spend what each wave drops on damage, crit and six weapon mounts firing at once — then bank the run into a 453-node passive tree that carries into the next. A premium incremental tower defence: no ads, no timers, no energy bars.

release_games.name: Pending Review
release_games.description: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.

release_games.name: Alchemaidens
release_games.description: A magical-girl roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker hands, stack Charms until the math breaks, then fuse four Awakened maidens of one rank into a Final Form with its own signature power. 81 Charms, 15 Orders, and 28 villainesses between you and Cycle 8.

release_games.name: Leverage Real Estate Simulator
release_games.description: Leverage Real Estate Simulator is an incremental clicker game. Play as an ambitious, ruthless property developer and expand your capital empire through a cycle of borrowing money, buying land, constructing and selling properties—all while stacking every form of leverage you can find.

release_games.name: Space Catnips
release_games.description: Space Catnips is an incremental game where you harvest catnips from alien planets and showcase them in your bar to attract a wide variety of space cats!

release_games.name: F Of X
release_games.description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

release_games.name: Here Comes the Horde
release_games.description: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

release_games.name: Wheel Be Fine
release_games.description: The world has gone dark! Only your hamsters can fix it. Spin the wheel, collect strange little hamsters and keep upgrading so your room powers the city, the country and the whole planet. A cozy incremental clicker.

release_games.name: Colorways
release_games.description: Colorways is a minimalist traffic management game in which you help colorful traffic navigate various intersections while avoiding traffic jams and accidents. Unique modifiers and daily challenges present ever-changing levels and opportunities to climb the leaderboards.

release_games.name: Breakfast Shop Legend
release_games.description: Run a Taiwanese breakfast shop in this fast-paced time-management sim! Fry egg crepes, deep-fry nuggets, and mix drinks by hand. Every round ends in a frantic Rush Hour. Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

release_games.name: Demockracy
release_games.description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

release_games.name: CapyHaven
release_games.description: Two capybaras found a meadow past the river. Lead them into a colony: buy land one hex at a time and choose what each tile becomes. Build huts and hot springs, throw festivals, welcome babies. Gentle nights, a full Pacifist option and no lose state.

release_games.name: Little Noël: Christmas Village
release_games.description: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

release_games.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
release_games.description: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

release_games.name: Butaro's Overtime Office
release_games.description: A desktop companion about escaping the 9-to-5. Adopt Butaro, a burnt-out salaryman who lives anywhere on your screen. Watch him slack off from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and upgrade his corporate skills while you work or relax. Will Butaro escape corporate burnout before you do?

release_games.name: The Trivia Show
release_games.description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, axe-wielding gnomes, revolvers on the table and much more.

release_games.name: Angel Investor Simulator™
release_games.description: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

release_games.name: Cube Fold
release_games.description: Cube Fold is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game where every move unfolds the cube into new shapes. Solve handcrafted levels filled with teleporters, jump tiles, moving platforms, bridges, and clever mechanics. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

release_games.name: Rogue's Cog
release_games.description: A steampunk bubble-shooter roguelike. Load the cannon. Match the color. The ceiling drops. Nine mutations to level, one score to take, no second run — until you or the tower is done.

release_games.name: Loopfall
release_games.description: Hardcore reflex arcade. Two buttons, three modes, one brutal neon tunnel, and a new Daily Challenge every day on the same tunnel for every player. Dodge endless gates, blast electric time-attack, or thread capsule mines on a track engineered for skill, not luck.

release_games.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
release_games.description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for justice.

release_games.name: Watch and Whisper
release_games.description: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!

release_games.name: Way Too Many Fish!
release_games.description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

release_games.name: Lots of Axos
release_games.description: A tiny lab, a simple tank and a pair of very curious axolotls. Care for them, decorate their home and watch the family grow, egg by egg, each one a different surprise. With your care, this species can thrive again.

release_games.name: Riftweaver's Deck
release_games.description: Riftweaver's Deck is a card roguelite deckbuilding autobattler. Recruit heroes, better your equipment and skills. Travel through the rift portals to encounter powerful foes and friends. Be Victorious on your quest, and Vanquish the Dark Riftweaver and his morphlings!

release_games.name: Temple Of The Machine God
release_games.description: The universe is over. You are the last human alive inside a superstructure orbiting an evaporating black hole and its taking you with it. Can you find the truth about what happened to Humanity and The Machine God while finding a way to escape?

release_games.name: The Chairman
release_games.description: Run a football club from the corner of your screen. Sign players, negotiate contracts, build the stadium and climb ten divisions while the matches play themselves. Step in when a decision needs you, then get back to your day.

release_games.name: My Little Ranch
release_games.description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Breed one-of-a-kind horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

release_games.name: I, Spy
release_games.description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

release_games.name: Func Key
release_games.description: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

release_games.name: Quiz Show Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own high-stakes quiz show by crafting questions, choosing contestants, and making production decisions to grow your audience, boost ratings, and earn more money!

release_games.name: KAFAK
release_games.description: KAFAK – Survival Card-Building & Base Management Game Build your deck with 150+ unique cards, upgrade characters and your base, craft Thai dishes, hunt and farm to survive, and face 10+ powerful bosses in a post-apocalyptic world.

release_games.name: MEAT PARADE
release_games.description: Kill endless enemies and become a god among a plethora of enemies and bosses. With FPS movement controls Kill to progress, pick your upgrades and make unique builds as you fight the horde.

release_games.name: Lewd Temple: Hentai Clicker
release_games.description: A saucy 2D idle clicker where ancient Egypt meets seductive waifus. Tap to fight, defeat bosses to recruit bold new companions, and upgrade your girls to battle automatically. Chat with them in an in-game messenger and grow your collection.

release_games.name: NodalBastion
release_games.description: Defend the last AI core in a minimalist incremental game as you manage resources, upgrade your network, and unleash powerful skills. Resist humanity’s onslaught!

release_games.name: Birza
release_games.description: A desktop birding simulator.Here, you won't need to worry about feeding or raising the birds.Simply leave it running quietly on your desktop, and adorable birds will visit on their own.You can purchase food and feed them.Use the camera to capture their cute moments.Create personalized birding books.

release_games.name: No Alibi
release_games.description: Rob banks, collect bounties, and gamble it all away in No Alibi. Up to 4 players work together to lead their criminal empire to success. Use your customized guns and equipment to take hostages and steal everything you can. Just make sure the boss gets paid.

release_games.name: Elfscape: Ancestors
release_games.description: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.

release_games.name: Chef's Adventure
release_games.description: Tomorrow is Harry's birthday. The Chef only wants to bake a simple cake, but the chickens have broken out and cleared out the whole pantry. Chase them through 5 worlds and 10 levels, learn new moves along the way and get the cake on the table.

release_games.name: HARMA
release_games.description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

release_games.name: Lucky Grid
release_games.description: A cosy two-hour pixel game about a table of lucky machines in an old house. Toss the coin, roll the dice, spin the wheel and pull the slots, automate them all, step into the garden inside a plant and climb to the attic, where a ginger cat talks in cat.

release_games.name: Mini Battleships
release_games.description: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

release_games.name: Off the Table!
release_games.description: An incremental game about a cat and a table crowded with stuff. Before your human gets back, knock mugs, toys, phones and grand pianos onto the floor: things that clearly don't belong on a table. Spend points on upgrading your cat.

release_games.name: Egg Harvest
release_games.description: Egg Harvest is a roguelike farming game where you try to save your farm from debt. Produce eggs with your chickens, complete contracts, choose powerful upgrades, and fill your egg catalog. Keep producing until your debt is paid off!

release_games.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
release_games.description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

release_games.name: Project Hole
release_games.description: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.

release_games.name: GraviSmack
release_games.description: Bend gravity, skate across impossible surfaces, and smash through swarms in GraviSmack, a movement-driven action roguelite. Build a wild mix of weapons and boons, unlock new characters, and fight solo or with friends.

release_games.name: Shai & Shatta
release_games.description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

release_games.name: Ringfort
release_games.description: Six forts. One brawl. An asynchronous auto-battler where six ringforts fight all at once. Spend cattle on items, arrange them on your walls, chase race bonds or cross-race item styles, and take on both neighbours every round. Be the last fort standing, then climb six rings to become High King.

release_games.name: Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
release_games.description: Turn time spent working or studying into time shared with a cat. Settle into a room you've made your own, find a work-and-break rhythm with a Pomodoro timer, and unlock new furniture as your focus time adds up.

release_games.name: BLOWHOLE
release_games.description: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

release_games.name: Shift 233
release_games.description: You are a new night shift employee at Station 4 on Shift 233. You work in a small, windowless room where you listen to microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. What starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange and uncanny presence within the cracks of the earth.

release_games.name: ALIEN 50
release_games.description: Tower defense, run and gun and a helicopter shoot 'em up in one 2D game. Lead Sergeant Steve through World 1 (10 long stages), face another player in the 1v1 online duel and push your limits in 4 endless modes. 4 more worlds arrive in the coming weeks: 50 stages in total.

release_games.name: We Are Surrounded
release_games.description: Four heroes stand back to back on a floating island as hundreds of monsters close in. Place their rally points, then watch them fight on their own. Spend the loot on five upgrade trees, come back stronger and defeat the enemies.

release_games.name: Dear Gravity
release_games.description: Fold a paper plane, throw it from your window and deliver letters farther and farther from home: over the rooftops and the dunes, up to the mountains. One plane you build yourself, 128 letters and a calm, painted world.

release_games.name: Where are my keys?
release_games.description: Lost your car keys at the beach? Or was it the woods? Grab a metal detector and a shovel, dig up junk and treasure, flog it to a shady Fence for upgrades and find those keys, with no rush, before a tsunami hits, or before the bear comes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

release_games.name: Firewheels Tidy Up Sort Together
release_games.description: A cozy co-op organizing sim in a diecast toy car shop. Sort 7,600+ blister cards and collector boxes of 200 car models onto peg walls, glass cabinets and giant wheel shelves, solo or with up to 4 players. Unlock skills and turn the pile-up into a perfect display.

release_games.name: Tuftwood : Rug Tufting Simulation
release_games.description: Tuft cozy rugs for a town full of customers. Stretch the cloth, fire the tufting gun, glue, flip, shave and carve each rug by hand, then deliver it to their home. Grow your little studio with new yarns, tools and decorations, or turn any picture into a rug of your own.

release_games.name: Gaslamp Cases 12: The Silent Codex
release_games.description: In this thrilling Match-3 adventure you have to uncover a deadly mystery. When Nobel-winning Professor Lyle Hemsworth dies under mysterious circumstances, detectives Morgan Johnson and Jack Brown are pulled into a chilling investigation that blurs the line between reality and madness

release_games.name: When Ren Ran
release_games.description: A morning jog turned Ren into a spirit. To regain his human form, he'll have to negotiate with the local spirits — each with their own conditions. A fairy-tale point-and-click puzzle game, hand-drawn.

release_games.name: Dave: Leg it
release_games.description: Dave’s starving and the chippy shuts soon. Run, dash, swing and slime your way across 16 levels of grim British streets in this fast, frantic speedrun platformer. Beat your best, race your ghost and get Dave his chips while they’re still hot.

release_games.name: EverArcane
release_games.description: Build a 3×3 grid of spells and watch your young mage obliterate endless monster hordes. Combine six elements, chain reactions and adjacency buffs, defeat ten Guardians, and push through the horde of monsters.

release_games.name: Puzzle Sea Stars
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Impression Cabinet
release_games.description: A jigsaw puzzle game set in a print workshop. Assemble 24 archival and original prints with distinct piece cuts, free rotation, and room to build off the board. Finish each Working Proof to reveal the completed print, then file it in your Cabinet. Selected prints offer a Second Look challenge.

release_games.name: Crack the Bills
release_games.description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

release_games.name: Tinselwood
release_games.description: Paint homes, markets, and workshops into a snowy valley and the townsfolk build a Christmas town around them. Build freely, or earn it title by title in Progression Mode. No timers and no way to lose: just lanes, lights, falling snow, sixteen festive set pieces and a town to walk as your own elf.

release_games.name: CrackBound
release_games.description: CrackBound is a 3D tabletop companion game based around gem generation and automation. Produce ores, watch stones move on conveyor belts, earn money and develop your growing industrial facility.

release_games.name: Seashell Hoarder: Tidy Up
release_games.description: A cozy first-person beachcombing game where you gather, clean, and shelve thousands of seashells along a sun-warmed coastline. Sort each find into its rightful place, restore the shore, and turn a scattered coastline into a curated collection at your own pace.

release_games.name: IWA Fighting Adventure
release_games.description: An auto battler with base building. Grow your Village, gather resources, then plan IWA's behavior before each automatic battle. Mix Skills, Spells from three schools of magic and Potions to beat 8 regional bosses and free the land.

release_games.name: Hexel
release_games.description: Hexel is a puzzle game unlike any other. Learn the rules and overcome over 100 levels, each exploring a different aspect of every mechanic introduced. This game respects your intellect with no filler puzzles, every level requires you to find a new way to approach the problem.

release_games.name: Arks of Twilight
release_games.description: Build a warband of fairy-tale creatures in a single-player auto battler. Choose your Guide, recruit and merge cards, then arrange your formation to face seven rivals. Discover 20 factions and 300 creatures, with automatic battles and decisions between every duel.

release_games.name: Advancing Legion
release_games.description: This is a relaxing idle auto-battler game.Starting as a lone hero, gradually recruit powerful subordinates to form a mighty legion, upgrade powerful abilities, and then conquer the entire world.

release_games.name: Out Of Hours
release_games.description: Back a 53-foot trailer into the last open stall at a busy truck stop, at two in the morning. Ten real truck stops, real trailer handling, weather and traffic, and a morning pull-out after your ten-hour break.

release_games.name: Cubes&Cards
release_games.description: Cubes & Cards is a Rougelike Platform Fighter; Fight your friends and gain power from over 20 cards to choose from! With 3 characters with unique playstyles, the possibilities are endless!

release_games.name: Is This Reversi?
release_games.description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

release_games.name: JOINT LIABILITY
release_games.description: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.

release_games.name: Warpack
release_games.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

release_games.name: Lucky Crafter
release_games.description: A potion-brewing roguelite on a four-ring wheel. Every combination of ingredients is its own potion, with over 4,000 to discover. Ingredients add up, bottles multiply the price and boosts push it further. Pick runes and reach growing delivery targets before your spins run out.

release_games.name: Of Dice and Minions
release_games.description: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.

release_games.name: Wildcat
release_games.description: Wildcat is a top-down fast-paced roguelite dungeon crawler featuring powerful witchcraft and intense boss fights. Discover hundreds of items, combine them to master the elements, defeat guardians and rival witches, then rescue the lost cats!

release_games.name: Background RPG
release_games.description: Turn your everyday PC activity into an RPG adventure! Every click and keystroke helps your knight fight the undead, gain XP and find powerful loot. Equip new gear, grow stronger and rise through the ranks.

release_games.name: Crossroad Chaos
release_games.description: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.

release_games.name: PRIEST
release_games.description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

release_games.name: Spearfish
release_games.description: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.

release_games.name: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
release_games.description: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

release_games.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
release_games.description: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.

release_games.name: The Kings Last Hand
release_games.description: The Kingdom is under siege. Gather powerful cards, and build unique defensive strategies to withstand increasingly deadly enemy assaults. Each defeat teaches a lesson. Each victory unlocks new possibilities.

release_games.name: Elecade
release_games.description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

release_games.name: Greedy Getaways
release_games.description: Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways! Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!

release_games.name: Impossible Wonders
release_games.description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

release_games.name: ETCH
release_games.description: A fast top-down roguelike maze-runner. 4 abilities, 78 upgrades, and 47 gadgets (12 of them risky) for countless builds. 6 enemy types and 6 escalating boss designs across a 30-level descent.

release_games.name: Topdeck Automat
release_games.description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

release_games.name: Sound System
release_games.description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

release_games.name: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver
release_games.description: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver is a fast paced rogue-like platformer with an emphasis on fluid movement, satisfying combat, and fearsome challenges. With unique abilities to master, tightly generated levels, and the ever-looming threat of Death, each run has something new to experience.

release_games.name: Survidle Knight
release_games.description: Enter the dungeon. Fight powerful foes. Die. Upgrade. Repeat. Survidle Knight is an idle RPG dungeon crawler with survivor-like elements and no input during gameplay.

release_games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
release_games.description: Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just Umbra, a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

release_games.name: Football Referee Life Simulator 26
release_games.description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

release_games.name: Block King Demands Red Squares
release_games.description: Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy. Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.

release_games.name: Survivors Under Siege
release_games.description: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

release_games.name: Ultimate Rally 2D
release_games.description: Ultimate Rally 2D is the ultimate top-down rally game, with multiple rally disciplines: rally, rallycross and rally raid, single-player, online multiplayer and time trial modes. Make your own tracks/vehicles and share them with others.

release_games.name: Glowgrove
release_games.description: Grow a cozy mushroom garden that keeps growing while you're away. Plant spore packets in six painted habitats, mist your mushrooms, discover 42 species and their rare variants, cross them into hybrids, and watch the grove glow at night.

release_games.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
release_games.description: Build a team of gotchimon, pick their moves and fighting order, then watch them battle on their own. Play the story campaign, take on other players' teams in the PvP Arena, and keep a run going in a small corner window while you work.

release_games.name: Olympegs
release_games.description: Join Zeus and the gods of Olympus on a bouncing trip from the mountaintop down to Tartarus. Aim, fire and clear every gold peg, then ride the ball back up the board for a x5 finish.

release_games.name: Wolves In The Flock
release_games.description: By day, tend your flock on a bright little farm. By night, guard the gate while three strangers beg to come in. Some are sheep running for their lives. Some are wolves in wool. Ask the right questions, open the gate or don't, and trust no fleece. Watch your flock and maybe save the world.

release_games.name: My Sister
release_games.description: 'My Sister' is a casual Visual Novel JRPG. Play as 25-year-old Jung-boong, taking on jobs and adventures to heal his depressed younger sister. Complete non-combat quests, and battles to unlock multiple endings and event CGs!

release_games.name: Silicon Tycoon
release_games.description: A pixel-art business tycoon. Run an electronics and car company from 1980 to today: research 45 years of tech, design desktops, laptops, phones, cars and engines part by part in 3D, build your campus and fight twelve rival companies for every market.

release_games.name: BeatSlayer
release_games.description: Every enemy moves on the beat. Fly one of four ships through a cyberpunk three-act run, meet 210 strange encounters, play 24 minigames, unlock a new relic with every stage you clear, fuse weapons into 1,378 fusions, and see how deep Endless goes.

release_games.name: Online Poly
release_games.description: Roll the dice, buy world cities, and make your rivals pay the toll! Online Poly is a free online board game with cute characters, property-building battles, global rankings, and a Tile Lift map that turns the board upside down.

release_games.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
release_games.description: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless business expenses, outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

release_games.name: Ballpeak
release_games.description: One wrong move, and it's a long way down! Master five ball materials, each with unique handling, in Ballpeak—a physics-based 3D platformer. Balance your momentum, cross narrow bridges, and overcome tricky obstacles to reach the finish.

release_games.name: Crowns & Colossi
release_games.description: Choose among 13 distinct fantasy kingdoms: appoint ministers, balance the treasury and maneuver on the world map, then command legions in turn-based battles with war-strategy cards and towering giants. Roguelike runs, branching stories and multiple endings.

release_games.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
release_games.description: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

release_games.name: Corporate Dash
release_games.description: Corporate Dash is a hilarious party racing game for 2–9+ players! Use your smartphones to place bets, play sneaky cards, and watch your office colleagues race through hilarious chaos. Outsmart your friends, survive unexpected disasters, and climb the corporate ladder!

release_games.name: Villa Anzuelo: The Obituarist
release_games.description: A writing commission takes you to a mansion above the sea. Uncover its secrets, listen to its inhabitants and piece together a story in which the dead still have something to say.

release_games.name: Cycle of the First Dawn
release_games.description: A slow, story-rich xianxia idle RPG about cultivation, discovery, and reincarnation. Work, train, explore, and uncover new systems across repeated lives. Progress carries forward, the world changes, and each journey reveals more than the last.

release_games.name: Outbreak Checkpoint
release_games.description: Outbreak Checkpoint is a survival defense game where your inventory shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, merge upgrades, and fit attachments into a limited grid. Combine four elements to unleash powerful reactions and hold the line against growing enemy hordes.

release_games.name: Puzzle Dinosaur Skeletons
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Backpack Ascendancy
release_games.description: Fit weapons, armor and relics into your backpack as you progress through the dungeon! Neighboring items give each other bonuses and find rare Catalyst Stone to automate whatever touches it. Get stronger by unlocking a 200+ Ascendancy tree between runs, and play solo or in online co-op with a friend!

release_games.name: Heartrift
release_games.description: Low scores. High stakes. HEARTRIFT is a single-player tactical card roguelike. Reveal cards, replace high values and clear matching columns. Develop four colour paths, combine relics and choose your route through a fractured world.

release_games.name: THE BACKLOG
release_games.description: A used-game shop after closing, its floor buried under 5,000+ games and consoles. Pick one up, read the label, and put it on its console's shelf until the shop is tidy. A first-person tidying sim with no timer and no game over. Get faster, find small rewards, and play with up to 3 friends.

release_games.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
release_games.description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

release_games.name: Gestalt Journey
release_games.description: An incremental game (a clicker) where everything keeps growing while you decide where to put your resources. And a history lesson: as you play, you learn the real story of Gestalt therapy — its people, theories, books and organisations.

release_games.name: Scrapline
release_games.description: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

release_games.name: Starlit Solitaire
release_games.description: Catch your breath with classic Klondike under the stars. Shrinks to an always-on-top desktop window, like a pet.

release_games.name: Tomo-chan's Cleaning Panic
release_games.description: This is a fixed-screen action game reminiscent of 80s arcade titles. Use various items to clean floors and pick up trash—all while dodging rats and cockroaches—to tidy up the building within the time limit. The game features 30 levels in total and includes multiple endings

release_games.name: YoYo Blade
release_games.description: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.

release_games.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
release_games.description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

release_games.name: Lust Isles
release_games.description: Reclaim the Forsaken Isles in this NSFW fantasy adventure blending visual novel storytelling, RPG progression, and strategic match-3 combat. Battle monsters, unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your character, and build spicy relationships with the exotic and horny characters you meet along the way.

release_games.name: Aetherlob
release_games.description: Follow a rumor of a star that never goes out in this turn-based artillery roguelite. Read the wind, time charged shots and blast through terrain. Recruit companions across five layers, combine weapons and relics, and play solo or in online and LAN co-op.

release_games.name: PUSH MID
release_games.description: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.

release_games.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
release_games.description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

release_games.name: Hanafuda
release_games.description: Discover the traditional Japanese 🎴Hanafuda (花札 - Flower Cards) games, brought to life as a beautiful, modern 3D tabletop game. Match cards to create pairs, complete a set and collect points, or call Koi-Koi to risk it all for more. Play against the computer, or other players online.

release_games.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
release_games.description: A Japanese horror-mystery. Trapped in an inn room, you survive by obeying rules that grow every night. By morning, use the guest register to learn who the earlier guests were and how they died. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is.

release_games.name: Snake Echos
release_games.description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

release_games.name: Sangoku Bump
release_games.description: A Three Kingdoms roguelite auto-battler. Recruit and upgrade generals, build powerful synergies with cards and equipment, and arrange your formation before your team clashes in automatic battles. Test your builds against other players' teams in asynchronous PvP.

release_games.name: Tiny Chef
release_games.description: A co-op restaurant management sim for 1-4 players. Chop, fry and plate orders against a ticking clock, then spend the takings between shifts on new appliances, conveyor automation, knocked-down walls and a second restaurant across town.

release_games.name: Airport 7
release_games.description: You are trapped in an endless airport terminal. Observe your surroundings carefully, find the anomalies, and find your way out.

release_games.name: I AM MILK
release_games.description: Close your eyes. Listen. I AM MILK is a surreal, darkly comic game played entirely through sound, with one button and more than 40 endings. You have 21 minutes and 30 seconds to do something meaningful with your life. Put on your headphones.

release_games.name: Dust Vein
release_games.description: A co-op horror game for 1-4 players set in the dead underground bunkers of Earth. Collect loot, fulfill the quota, feed the living reactor, and descend deeper and deeper into the mines.

release_games.name: Dungebra
release_games.description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

release_games.name: Untold Memories: Grandma's House
release_games.description: Rick is forced to spend a week at his grandmother’s house, where every night grows more disturbing. Explore a house filled with whispers, survive paranormal events, and uncover the secret hidden beneath it all while one warning echoes in your mind: never enter the basement..

release_games.name: Key Strokes
release_games.description: AIM, TYPE, and HIT in this top-down golf game where your typing prowess determines your shot.

release_games.name: Yami Mura
release_games.description: Emica is a teenager struggling with family problems and schizophrenia. She wakes up alone in Yami Mura, a silent village where something stalks her. To escape, she must solve its mysteries and light the six lanterns. Is she still alive, or is her mind trapping her?

release_games.name: TopiaLand
release_games.description: Build your own land block by block, grow and crossbreed seeds, trade with players and show off your style in a cosy online sandbox. Claim your land with a Land Crystal, swim, farm, craft and explore lands built by the community.

release_games.name: Rico Rite
release_games.description: A breakout roguelike where the balls fight for you. Draft a party of bouncing heroes, aim them into descending swarms, and chain ricochets to climb a combo meter that speeds your heroes up.

release_games.name: Our campus life
release_games.description: Our campus life is an AVG set against the backdrop of modern university life. In an alternate contemporary world, players step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience a story where sports, friendship, and even romance intertwine with multiple characters.

release_games.name: Water Maid
release_games.description: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

release_games.name: In Waiting
release_games.description: In Waiting is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a haunted manor guided by Eleanor, an AI-powered ghost. Solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and experience true AI conversations that run 100% on your device with zero data collection.

release_games.name: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira
release_games.description: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira is a fighting game that features capoeira as its main fighting style. In this game, you'll experience numerous characters and ways to fight capoeira. Let's get moving!

release_games.name: Green Dragon/グリーンドラゴン
release_games.description: Tougo is a distinguished martial artist recruited by a British intelligence agency takes part in a fierce fight against mysterious Cannabis drugs lord Taito, who is also responsible for Dee's fathers death. Together with agent Alice they discover the drug lair situated at an urban city... Fight agai

release_games.name: A Respectable Family
release_games.description: 1:47 a.m. A high-school classmate forwards you his father's obituary: “There's something I should have given back to you a long time ago.” Then his phone goes dark. By morning, another name heads the obituary. Before the funeral procession, trace all 86 people in his family from your computer.

release_games.name: Roger Running Tree Wages War Against God
release_games.description: Roger running tree was enjoying his afternoon and kind bud, when he noticed some commotion outside. Upon investigation, Roger finds his home ravaged by an unknown enemy: the white man. By the grace of the spirits, the village elder tasked their greatest warrior, Roger, to rid their land of strife.

release_games.name: Under the Aurora
release_games.description: A mystery quest exploring life, death, and the path to return.

release_games.name: Bottle King
release_games.description: From collecting bottles in the city park to founding the Cosmic Deposit Council: gather empties, hire helpers and grow a recycling empire that stretches from a small town to the edge of the universe. A relaxed pixel-art idle game that keeps running on the side.

release_games.name: Spirit Tide
release_games.description: Cast your line into the ocean in Spirit Tide, a simple 2D fishing simulator! Catch legendary fish, discover new species, earn coins, and upgrade your fishing rods. Explore exciting ocean events and see what awaits you beneath the waves! Available for only €0.99!

release_games.name: Rocket Punt
release_games.description: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.

release_games.name: Between Dreams
release_games.description: Tired of the same routine, you long for an exciting challenge. Climb higher through strange obstacles that seem to hold you back, as if they do not want you to wake from a dream. The higher you go, the more you wonder: is this world even real?

release_games.name: Hunter Bro VR
release_games.description: Arcade bow-and-gun hunting in VR. Take down big game across five wild grounds, unleash absurd cheats, and try not to get eaten.

release_games.name: Gold Idle
release_games.description: Flip a coin, land a plus, and grow your income. In Gold Idle, you can time your clicks, chase critical hits, or build around a Phantom that flips beside you. Forge your coin piece by piece, then rip open foil packs for cards that earn Gold. Many more consistent updates with days of new progression

release_games.name: BuzzBuzz
release_games.description: Your desktop is now its hunting ground. BuzzBuzz is a desktop pet that actually behaves like one — not a game inside a window, but a mosquito flying over your desktop, between your files and along your taskbar. It is right there, above your files. All that stands between you and it is one slap.

release_games.name: KNURLWORM
release_games.description: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The KNURLWORM.

release_games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
release_games.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

release_games.name: Glorybound
release_games.description: The horde moves when you end your turn. Command up to three champions in a turn-based survival roguelite. Reposition, combine spells, and shatter frozen enemies with steel. Survive 100 rounds and spend earned renown on permanent upgrades.

release_games.name: Chisel Me This
release_games.description: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

release_games.name: Bandits are Coming
release_games.description: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

release_games.name: Her Next Chapter
release_games.description: A cozy sticker game about finding your place after graduation. Arrange little objects to build street corners, a rented room, and a dream garden full of cats. Follow a young woman's next chapter, one sticker and one small kindness at a time.

release_games.name: Holtmezo
release_games.description: The villagers were conducting an experiment, but it went wrong and they were transformed into monsters. You are a soldier and must clear the village of monsters.

release_games.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters
release_games.description: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.

release_games.name: The Silence the Woods Keep
release_games.description: 2D action with incremental progression and horror elements. Freely explore the forest, chop trees, and upgrade gear by day. By night, choose to risk it all for valuable resources while facing dangerous monsters with unique behaviors.

release_games.name: Physical Yut
release_games.description: Yut without waiting for turns. Build energy, throw the sticks, stack and capture pieces, and turn the match around with skills.

666. The devil has spoken. She wants you to roll the dice. Why? Nobody knows. She needs a six. Then maybe another. Then maybe 666. A short dice rolling game: throw, buy upgrades that bend the odds, and keep rolling until she gets what she wants.

release_games.name: Touch Grass, Pls!
release_games.description: Finally, touch grass. Comb a hill of grass with your mouse, pick flowers, catch fireflies and wait for rare visitors, from a frog to a dragon at night. Or make the hill your live desktop wallpaper. Free, relaxing and impressively unproductive. The grass can wait.

release_games.name: Mart: Tidy Up Together
release_games.description: Tidy up to 19,026 objects across a two-floor store with 25 departments. Pick up products, restock shelves, fold clothes and earn upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players.

release_games.name: Arcane Chess Realm
release_games.description: A free online 1v1 tactics game combining chess-inspired movement with deckbuilding. Build a 24-card deck, move your pieces, and use cards to outmaneuver your opponent. Contest river chests, adapt to spreading danger zones, and defeat the enemy commander. All battle cards are unlocked.

release_games.name: Puzzle Seahorses
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Fossils
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Grandparadox
release_games.description: Go back through time and kill Grandad. A co-op board game with absurd weapons used to hunt your Grandfather throughout the decades to create the ultimate grandfather paradox... The Grandparadox! Play solo with bot helpers, or with up to 9 other people in online multiplayer!

release_games.name: Doodlefolk
release_games.description: Bring a little company to your Windows desktop. Meet procedural doodles with distinct personalities, watch friendships and skills grow, and give your doodles props and activities while you work or unwind. Customize their world with your own mods or ones from Steam Workshop.

release_games.name: 球球幸存者 · Ball Survivor
release_games.description: A 2D survivor action game. Players choose hidden heroes such as Little Mage and Wave Swordsman to survive and strengthen their skills in the constantly surging tide of enemies, challenge their limits - and fully enjoy the decompression and dopamine pleasure brought by bullet screen monster clearing.

release_games.name: VectorForce
release_games.description: Arm yourselves as ace agents and engage in high-octane light-gun action in this retro-inspired arcade rail shooter. Take on a ruthless criminal organisation shooting down waves of enemies and challenging bosses that will put your reflexes to the test while the city is on the brink of crisis.

release_games.name: Sort Them Dice
release_games.description: Turn a scattered hoard into a collection worth admiring. Collect, inspect and sort 4,235 dice into 605 sets across six themed areas. Fill wooden displays and unlock helpful upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.

release_games.name: Lost Luggage
release_games.description: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.

release_games.name: Hold On! Let Me Level Up!
release_games.description: Black spores fell with the acid rain, and within three months the city drowned in the dead. You're one of the few still holding a gun: dodge through the horde, grab loot, level up, merge nine items into one back at base, and fight your way to the source of the horde.

release_games.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
release_games.description: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

release_games.name: The Hollow Servant
release_games.description: Step into the shoes of writer Robert Baum in a quiet Arkansas town where something is deeply wrong. Explore a haunted home, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover a disturbing supernatural mystery in this first-person psychological horror game.

release_games.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨
release_games.description: Crime pays in this city, but the girls want their cut too. 💋 Rise from small-time crook to legend of the neon streets, charm the women who can open the right doors, and keep your foot on the gas when the sirens get too close

release_games.name: STAR FELIDEA
release_games.description: Pop bubbles, earn foam, and clean the album to recover photos of your adorable cats! Master your tools, chain combos, and discover a cute, colorful, bubbly arcade game packed with surprises. 🐱✨

release_games.name: Chronicle Hands
release_games.description: Build high-scoring hands from shared traits in this deck-building roguelike. Combine 100 historical figures, 124 Legacies and 114 Event Cards. Add marks, draw or import your own cards, and challenge 100 historical bosses!

release_games.name: MARS3077
release_games.description: A pixel-art action RPG inspired by Metal Max on the Famicom. Pilot a transforming mech across Mars and nine other worlds. Customize weapons and skills, uncover the mystery of pilot 404, and collect wild spirits to fight, evolve, and fuse into new companions.

release_games.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator
release_games.description: Run a parcel inspection desk. Weigh, X-ray and look up every shipment, compare it with the declaration and the latest regulations, then stamp and route it: approve, return, hold, confiscate or dispose. Earn cash, upgrade your workplace and keep up with a growing quota.

release_games.name: It Works On Paper
release_games.description: A spatial building puzzle about making three drawings agree. Match top, front and left views, keep every block connected to the ground, then carve away the excess. Explore 100 levels and find a solution that uses fewer blocks.

release_games.name: Dungeon Adventure Party
release_games.description: Recruit adventurers, build your party, and equip them for automatic battles as you venture deeper into the dungeon. This idle dungeon RPG is all about growing your team and finding the right combination for each fight.

release_games.name: TheDuckening
release_games.description: Bread, ducks, and pure chaos! Jump into The Duckening – a fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelike. Wield 50+ weapons, build crazy synergies with cards, upgrade unique ducks, fight bosses every 10 waves, and play built-in minigames!

release_games.name: Don't Blow UP!
release_games.description: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.

release_games.name: Race on Stream!
release_games.description: Little cars. Big grudges. Race solo, with Steam friends, or turn Twitch chat into your rivals. Upgrade your car, build your own tracks, throw a chair into the race, or leave it all behind for a long drive and some music.

release_games.name: Sort and Stack!
release_games.description: Turn an overflowing card market into your personal empire! Tear through cards, unlock powerful cutters, unleash five tiers of explosive booster packs, build your skill network, manipulate market prices, and grow stronger with every Prestige.

release_games.name: Hellmouth
release_games.description: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!

release_games.name: Water TD
release_games.description: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

release_games.name: Ball Pit Cleanup
release_games.description: Sort thousands of colorful balls into matching pipes. Unlock upgrades and work more efficiently, but be careful: every mistake adds more balls to the pile.

release_games.name: Paper Racer
release_games.description: Paper Racer is the racing game on squared paper, the one from your school exercise book. Move by move you set your line across the sheet and carry speed into the corners — brake too late and you land in the gravel. Draw your own tracks and race the computer or friends, locally or online.

release_games.name: VibeMarket OS
release_games.description: A free idle collectathon. Rip and trade player-made packs, grow an island of pixel Vibers, and earn tradable Nugget bags in your Steam inventory while the game stays open. Turn your own art into a pack. Built by Vibechain.

release_games.name: Legends of Mahjong
release_games.description: Learn and play Mahjong your way. Narrated tutorials, an in-game coach and guided practice hands teach Hong Kong and Japanese Riichi Mahjong, then play against AI opponents with your own house rules and 30 legendary characters.

release_games.name: One More Rule
release_games.description: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

release_games.name: Business Tycoon
release_games.description: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

release_games.name: TWENTY+
release_games.description: Draw toward 20. Turn the tables with + cards. TWENTY+ is a head-to-head card game with a shared deck numbered 1 to 11. Draw, stand, or change the target itself. Read your opponent's hidden card and time your + cards to swing the match. Play online or against the CPU.

release_games.name: Crazy Texas
release_games.description: A casino-grade poker table in a friend's game room. Sit down in first person, push your own chips and play No-Limit Hold'em against real players or AI regulars. Climb from Rookie to High stakes, or try a Crazy Table: Blackout, Crazy Pineapple, Forehead Poker and more. Free to play.

release_games.name: Time For Changes
release_games.description: During exam prep, Semyon faces a family crisis that leads to failure and a transfer to a troubled class. There, he encounters not only hostility but also makes new friends and meets girls who change his outlook on life. He must make tough choices between friendship, dreams, and harsh reality.

release_games.name: Puzzle Simulator
release_games.description: The one-more-piece puzzle game. Turn any photo into real 3D pieces, play solo or with up to 4 friends in online co-op, chase combos or keep it cozy, and make puzzles up to 40,000 pieces in The Lab.

release_games.name: Clandestined: Fade to Gray
release_games.description: A mystery sci-fi story, taking place inside an underground lab facility, where groundbreaking research is being conducted to make people immune to a bioweapon virus that destroyed civilisation. You're one of the test subjects and you're about to find out what comes next for humanity.

release_games.name: The Miner's Routine
release_games.description: A cozy pixel-art game about a miner sent to a remote island by order of the King. Mine resources, restore an abandoned mine, upgrade your tools, hire workers, and venture deeper underground to discover what lies beneath the mountain.

release_games.name: Nocturne
release_games.description: A strangely familiar signal reaches a lonely satellite station. Follow it through desolate lunar worlds in a short, atmospheric puzzle adventure.

release_games.name: Twisted Childhood
release_games.description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? You're going to corrupt them. Every tale is a different game — and make a Wish to bend its rules. Win your rounds... and your favorite princesses will never recover...

release_games.name: Aspect Arena
release_games.description: A siege auto-battler. Buy fighters, arm them, order the line, then watch sixty seconds decide it without you. Fifteen wins takes a campaign, one castle carries every wound it took getting there, and the rival Aspect opposite is building too.

release_games.name: Endless Battle: Idle & Build
release_games.description: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

release_games.name: Territory Idle Defense
release_games.description: recruit an ever-growing force of heroes in this pixel-art idle clicker RPG. Develop skill trees, unlock new territories, prestige for greater power, and come back stronger with every run.

release_games.name: LINETAIN
release_games.description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

release_games.name: Pigeon Ball
release_games.description: Pigeon Ball is a fast-paced first-person/third-person multiplayer sports game where pigeons fly, peck, pass and battle for the ball. Master your movement, outplay your opponents and score spectacular goals in chaotic arena matches.

release_games.name: HEXFORGE
release_games.description: Command a hex arena where your weapons fire themselves, but the build is yours. Mark targets, drop abilities, vent the heat. Between rounds, crack capsules, merge mods and rewire a 13-socket grid. Six zones, one long run, and a machine that slowly starts playing itself.

release_games.name: Wheat Awn: Line Zero
release_games.description: Wheat Awn: Line Zero is a single-player military strategy game about raising an army for the next impossible battle. Earn Star Coins in the Live-Fire Trial, recruit officers, buy supplies, expand your formation, master tactical cards at the Academy, then take Line Zero into 15 boss warzones.

release_games.name: The Highest School: Don’t Look Down
release_games.description: Your school is waiting at the very top - but to reach it, you’ll have to climb through history itself. Ascend from the Ancient World to the distant future, overcome obstacles, and whatever you do… don’t look down.

release_games.name: Tanto
release_games.description: You are stuck in seemingly endless rooms. Every step you take, every door you cross leave you in a room no different than the one before. Then you hear a little footstep - and you soon realize: you are not alone. Solve the puzzles and find your way out alive.

release_games.name: Pot O' Gnomes
release_games.description: Pot o' Gnomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

release_games.name: The Liminal Cleaner - The Pools
release_games.description: An atmospheric pixel-art cleaning game set in the Poolrooms. Explore abandoned pools and corridors, recover your tools, and scrub away grime using four cleaning methods. Watch the world change as you restore each area and uncover its secrets.

release_games.name: Minerooms
release_games.description: Minerooms is a first-person incremental mining game set in the backrooms. Mine thousands of blocks, collect energy, and feed an ancient statue to unlock permanent upgrades. Become faster and more powerful, blast deeper, and uncover what lies beyond.

release_games.name: Epoch Vault
release_games.description: Restore the lost history of the Mesozoic in an atmospheric idle game. Grow a branching discovery tree, uncover dinosaurs and vanished ecosystems, complete an illustrated scientific Codex, and rebuild the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous.

release_games.name: Public Faucet Hunt
release_games.description: Step into the shoes of Travis, the internet's favorite plumbing vigilante! Explore procedurally generated levels, test public faucets for the perfect flow, and evade city security in this endless, meme-inspired arcade stealth game powered by Unreal Engine 5.7.

release_games.name: Door Code
release_games.description: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.

release_games.name: Squadron 404
release_games.description: Retro top-down space shooter: hold the mothership through 100 waves, build your fighter from 22 modules and 26 modifiers, earn eight complete ship designs, and fly with up to 4 pilots in Steam co-op through stargate corridors, the asteroid belt and the fog convoy.

release_games.name: NODE ZERO
release_games.description: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.

release_games.name: The Offering Hour
release_games.description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Every summon, spell and deal costs seconds; even opening your grimoire costs one. Summon monsters against cunning hero bosses, then sacrifice three of your own to become a demon and fight in person.

release_games.name: Extract Survivors
release_games.description: Extraction survivors-like meets ARPG loot, with deep crafting you'll understand in one click. Melt the horde, fill your bag, extract through the portal. Die and it goes with your character. Your next one levels up faster and skips floors you already beat. How deep do you dare go?

release_games.name: The Joust Autochess
release_games.description: The Joust Autochess allows you to see your favorite zany physics brawlers in an environment like you've never seen them before... tactical autochess combat! Combine like cards to upgrade your forces! Strategize with items to find the perfect build!

release_games.name: The Peg Mines
release_games.description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

release_games.name: Business Wars
release_games.description: Build your business empire from company registration to IPO. Trade stocks with sector rotation, invest in residential and commercial real estate, navigate hundreds of life events, master acquisitions, VC financing, and banking. New Game+ with progress carryover. Every decision shapes your legacy.

release_games.name: Deep Rise
release_games.description: Colony management roguelite. After every combat, draft one of three cards to build your run. The surface world ended a thousand years ago. Now the road up is open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

release_games.name: Cozy Burg
release_games.description: A cozy hex city builder with real people and real jobs. You have to earn every resident: they want nature nearby, a job they can get to, and a street worth living on. You build it from a small hand of cards. Make it beautiful, make it work.

release_games.name: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure
release_games.description: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.

release_games.name: Talaire
release_games.description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

release_games.name: Sacrificium
release_games.description: Sacrificium is a dark psychological horror experience blending illustrated storytelling, branching choices, and sanity-driven gameplay. Trapped in a castle controlled by a satanic cult, you must escape before the nightmare consumes you.

release_games.name: Hacker Cats
release_games.description: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.

release_games.name: Lastrip
release_games.description: A girl and a vampire travel through a frozen world in this post-apocalyptic yuri visual novel. Read from Mei's perspective as she heads toward Huangshan, meets other survivors, and grows closer to the stranger who offered her a hand in the snow.

release_games.name: BagoLand
release_games.description: Bagoland is a unique community sandbox in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and roam the world.

release_games.name: Deathly Delights
