release_games.description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

release_games.name: Tie Down
release_games.description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

release_games.name: Spinova
release_games.description: A Slavic-myth slot roguelike. Build a deck of symbols, hang Ancients over the grid, bargain in the shop, and squeeze multipliers from every spin before the Kolovrat slips into a spiral for good.

release_games.name: Rascal
release_games.description: Rascal is an action roguelike where up to 4 players fight waves of enemies, gain gold, experience and purchase abilities.

release_games.name: Um Al-Saaf
release_games.description: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?

release_games.name: Drop That Pen
release_games.description: Drop your pen through cursed charms, bounce it into the cauldrons below, and upgrade your board between rounds in this hand-drawn, slightly haunted roguelite pachinko.

release_games.name: A.C.H.E.S.
release_games.description: Click, shop and minigame your way to the top. Collect clicks in order to ቻቹቹጋ ፱ነ buy upgrades, unlock collectables and get even more ጋቹረጎርጎዐ፱ነ clicks. Test your skills in a variety of mini games. Discover the story between the cracks. Do you have what it takes to prepare for the Grand Ascension?

release_games.name: Slay the Q
release_games.description: Score attack deck builder where you summon creatures to fight for you. Gain gold, buy magical Artifacts, enhance Cards with Runes, and create powerful combinations.

release_games.name: Cellular Frontier
release_games.description: Explore the organs of the human body to fight off the rampant infection and save the patient - with your friends, or solo!

release_games.name: Rogue Reels
release_games.description: Losing is not an option: Gamble your way up in this slot machine roguelite! Upgrade and manipulate the machines in your favor. Enhance your reels, win big and break the bank while defying ever-increasing odds.

release_games.name: Mellings
release_games.description: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

release_games.name: Dice Hoarder
release_games.description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

release_games.name: Gun Gone Wrong
release_games.description: A first-person survivors-like: trapped parents, a real gun in each hand, and hordes of teddy bears. Shoot your way out of child TV hell.

release_games.name: Mighty Mini Golf
release_games.description: Mighty Mini Golf is a wild mini golf adventure! Golf through crazy hazards using wild items in both single and local multiplayer modes. Fight and block hazards with swings of your club, fight dangerous bosses in single player mode, and explore map screens and unlock new characters and courses!

release_games.name: Alchedoom
release_games.description: A first-person alchemy roguelite. Wake in a dark lord's cell. Refine pills as tribute to survive. Handle pills, add ingredients, use fire. Success, damage or ruin: decide when to stop. Combine relics, catalysts and fire seeds to bend the odds. Face new trials daily. Will you live to escape?

release_games.name: Dodge Mayhem
release_games.description: A fast-paced top-down endless fighting game that turns it into an all-out arena fight, dodge , grab and throw your balls against waves of enemies.

release_games.name: The Intruder
release_games.description: This game is about escaping from a terrifying presence within an underground facility

release_games.name: Fighting Front
release_games.description: Fighting Front is a retro-inspired turn-based strategy wargame. Command your forces, capture territory, and secure resources across procedurally generated battlefields. Fight on hexagonal, triangular, or square maps against challenging AI opponents.

release_games.name: Void Revenant
release_games.description: Blast through 20 sectors in a pixel-art vertical shoot ’em up. Collect salvage, dock with an alien merchant and build an arsenal of lasers, missiles and drones. Break gigantic bosses, chase explosive combos and unlock new ships across four difficulties.

release_games.name: Knuckleball: Free Kick Football
release_games.description: Bend it. Dip it. Knuckle it. Pure free-kick football where you shape every strike, beat the wall, fool the keeper and rise from the local league to the national team.

release_games.name: ColorFarm
release_games.description: A cozy farming companion that lives in the corner of your desktop. Earn coins through everyday keyboard and mouse activity, grow colorful plants, turn each harvest into bead-art materials, create freely from patterns, collect your artwork, and expand your own floating farms.

release_games.name: Million Blocks
release_games.description: Destroy exactly one million blocks in this minimalist idle clicker. Click or automate, upgrade six endless branches, prestige, evolve, and climb the tier system

release_games.name: Three Kingdoms: Devour the World
release_games.description: A pixel-art idle strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms. Recruit 193 generals, build your team, set formations and assign treatises, then watch them fight through 57 campaigns, from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the rise of Jin, and on into the Immortal Trial and the Demon Realm.

release_games.name: Salmon Samurai
release_games.description: An arcade slicing game with a roguelike card draft. Slice leaping salmon out of the air, take one card every morning, and sell the catch to a raccoon who is openly robbing you. Miss the bill and the notice goes final. Fish don't pay bills. Slicing them does.

release_games.name: Asian Story
release_games.description: Help a floating island restore life in VR

release_games.name: GrassCutting
release_games.description: Take a breather after an intense gaming session. Choose your mowing tool, roam varied terrain, and clear wild plants in satisfying swaths. Upgrade, collect Golden Grass, use a time-stop ability, and try different weapons on a fresh, randomly generated map each run—all at your own pace.

release_games.name: Refund Me TD 2
release_games.description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

release_games.name: Toll Idle
release_games.description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

release_games.name: GOALTURN
release_games.description: Goalturn is a turn-based football card game. Pass, dribble and shoot across a painted 11v11 pitch, play tactic cards, pick one of six playing styles and collect over 250 players. Every risky move shows its chance before you commit.

release_games.name: Her Private Collection: Hentai Merge
release_games.description: Merge matching items to unlock revealing photos of 10 heroines. Plan your drops, use bonuses and special abilities, keep the board from overflowing, and collect all 70 rewards for your private gallery.

release_games.name: Nori Game 2
release_games.description: Nori Game 2 blends third-person action and real-time strategy for 1–4 players. Build your army, siege rival castles, steal treasure and forge secret alliances — or betray your friends! Command your soldiers, outsmart your enemies and be the first to secure five treasure chests. Trust no one!

release_games.name: So Many Cats!
release_games.description: Turn piles of plush cats into tidy shelves! So Many Cats! is a cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,608 plushies, unlock abilities and decorate your shop. No timers, no rush. Just one more cat!

release_games.name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
release_games.description: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.

release_games.name: ！？龙龙？！
release_games.description: A pixel shooter with automatic fire, random loot, and permanent upgrades. Steer your fighter left and right, combining gear, relics, and items packed with memes. Spend gold on the skill tree, chase survival records, and face a boss with three phases. Your next chest might hold a surprise!

release_games.name: APPENDIX C
release_games.description: Five contracts on machines you don't own, played at a real DOS command line. You can read every file on the volume for free — taking one is what gets noticed. Every run is ranked on how much noise you made.

release_games.name: Ascension Tournament
release_games.description: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.

release_games.name: Detective Club
release_games.description: Investigate crime scenes, question the people involved, and expose a lie with decisive evidence. Play two complete cases for free, including their endings and explanations. Continue your investigations with separately purchased casebooks.

release_games.name: Commando Squad
release_games.description: Lead four elite commandos behind enemy lines in 100 tactical stealth missions. Study patrols, slip past searchlights, take guards down silently and get the whole squad out alive. A classic squad-stealth tactics game, rebuilt for today.

release_games.name: Beauty Territory - Qix Fantasy
release_games.description: Hold Space and move with the arrow keys to draw lines, claim territory, and complete her picture! The most perfect QIX-style territory game. Claim 85% to clear; fill 100% for a special illustration and video. Six heroines, 63 stages, 126 illustrations and videos await.

release_games.name: Kinetile
release_games.description: Build a route for one rolling ball, then let physics test your plan. Arrange jumps, teleports and sliding platforms in this 3D puzzle. Solve 56 handcrafted levels, then keep going with endless generated puzzles in Infinity mode. No timer, no move limit.

release_games.name: Hentai Clicker: Akane is streaming
release_games.description: Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock Akane’s scenes, outfits, and voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Akane is streaming, a playful adult anime clicker.

release_games.name: SLOTDOWN
release_games.description: Grandpa left you an underground casino, a mountain of debt and a loan shark with a smile. Grow ten wild slot machines floor by floor, make allies or rivals, and outplay the Baron in a pop-art comic incremental. No real money. Ever.

release_games.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター
release_games.description: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.

release_games.name: Minami Co.
release_games.description: Kasumi, a maid café waitress in Akihabara, inherits her late father's safety-pin factory. Make pins, ship them, upgrade wacky machines, retool for global trends, and join her mom and sisters in chasing No.1 world share and a planet of safety pins. A pixel-art incremental factory comedy.

release_games.name: Round and Round Inc.
release_games.description: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.

release_games.name: Dreadmiles
release_games.description: Combine weapon modules, collect relics and spread fire in this rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, complete missions and take down giant bosses, then head back to your truck before the "Seep" engulfs you!

release_games.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE
release_games.description: Guide a cute, drifting sunfish through an underwater cave in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Dodge rocks, rubbish, shells, anemones, fish and charging orcas. Ride powerful currents, beat your best distance, and retry instantly when one collision ends your run.

release_games.name: AI面接官を突破せよ
release_games.description: 履歴書に「幽霊」「前世」「土下座」!? 指定された変なワードを全部入れて履歴書を書き、AI面接官の審査を突破せよ。質問はあなたの履歴書からAIがその場で考える。言い訳とこじつけで採用をもぎ取る、おバカ就活ゲーム。

release_games.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
release_games.description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

release_games.name: The Other End
release_games.description: An unexplained signal is answering you. Decode patterns, reconstruct recordings and build an understanding of an unknown intelligence in this atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure, with interconnected challenges and puzzle variations between playthroughs.

release_games.name: Tile Farmer
release_games.description: Build a thriving farm, one tile at a time. Grow crops, raise livestock, upgrade tractors, and expand your land in this pixel-art farming management game. Balance costs, crop rotation, and loans as you turn a small plot into a profitable operation.

release_games.name: Mosquito Problem
release_games.description: Survive as a mosquito in a punk musician’s apartment. Learn his habits, avoid his traps and slaps, drink his blood and upgrade your skills. Spend blood at the Roach Market, spin the Lucky Wheel for free boosts and explore an apartment full of fun, interactive things to do.

release_games.name: Snow Worries!
release_games.description: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

release_games.name: 2ndwaves
release_games.description: Connect 4+ blocks of the same color to clear them and build chain reactions. The controls are optimized for hard drops. Launch a second wave as you chase your target score. VS mode is also fun.

release_games.name: Road Riot
release_games.description: Vehicular combat survivor game. Dodge swarming enemies, evolve absurd weapons and smash huge bosses. Hot Mods change every drive and random modifiers make enemies unpredictable. Collect scrap, upgrade your garage, unlock new cars. Get wrecked. Come back louder.

release_games.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
release_games.description: A cozy first-person tidying game. Thousands of board game boxes lie scattered across a charming two-storey shop. Gather stacks of copies, shelve every game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.

release_games.name: Core Awakened
release_games.description: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.

release_games.name: Toys, Please!
release_games.description: Christmas is coming and the toy warehouse is a mess! Read the kids’ letters, find the right toys, pack them and pull the lever. But be careful! Some kids don’t deserve toys, and the coal crate is right there!

release_games.name: Battlegenics
release_games.description: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

release_games.name: Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade
release_games.description: A crimson moon rises over a spring festival and a hundred yokai pour into town. Lead six exorcists through the Night Parade, build your style from 13 Japanese weapons and 60 charms, defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox and the Great Tengu, and help the thousand-year sakura bloom again.

release_games.name: The Wife Next Door - She Drains Me While Her Husband's Away
release_games.description: A beautiful married woman moves in next door. One day, while her husband is away, she makes a bold move on you. Unable to resist her sweet temptation, you begin a secret affair filled with forbidden pleasure. A sweet and naughty relationship begins whenever her husband is away...

release_games.name: Taise-CityVsBus
release_games.description: This city has been swallowed by apocalyptic chaos. The crew entered the streets before you and are still fighting. You are the bus driver. Drive through the city and rescue the scattered crew in this exhilarating apocalyptic bus action game!

release_games.name: Kepler Ascent
release_games.description: Grapple, wall-run and rocket your way up 12 chapters of the Kepler-9 against the clock. Fixed routes, Bronze-to-AURA medals, a ghost to beat, plus ranked duels and a battle royale. Every fall is recorded.

release_games.name: One More Lawn
release_games.description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

release_games.name: UPSHOT
release_games.description: Every hit splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls keep breaking into smaller, faster ones. Clear room after room against the clock, open mystery gift boxes and take down a giant boss every fifth room, solo or in co-op.

release_games.name: My Spooky Photo Store Lydia
release_games.description: My Spooky Photo Store: Lydia is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game with 20 progressively challenging levels. Solve each puzzle to unlock the next chapter of Lydia's story, leading to a final exciting sequence.

release_games.name: DesktopKins
release_games.description: Bring your desktop to life with playful 3D companions. Customize your DesktopKins, play soccer and other mini-games, and watch them interact with windows and icons. Keep up to four companions by your side, using included characters or your own compatible VRM models.

release_games.name: Hellterns
release_games.description: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

release_games.name: FLOWFALL Inertia
release_games.description: Race and battle with up to four players online across PC and Android, or compete against computer rivals in CIRCUIT. Steer a falling shape, change it to fit gates timed to an original soundtrack, and choose routes through 15 worlds. Includes solo modes and courses built from your own music.

release_games.name: Tiny Tavern
release_games.description: At the edge of a rainy town, the undead keep themselves together, ghosts pay their tab, and the cat on the barrel is not for sale. You run the tavern: the pan sizzles, the ale foams over. Night after night, a hooded figure sits in the far corner, drinking nothing but chamomile tea.

release_games.name: Calamity Quarry
release_games.description: A meteor has fallen. You're here to mine it. Rest your cursor on the stone, grow your devices through a sprawling skill map, and invoke the next calamity. What falls next, we won't tell you. Pray.

release_games.name: Hentai World Train
release_games.description: Relax with soothing puzzles, unlock beautiful anime-inspired artwork, and enjoy increasingly engaging challenges at your own pace—perfect for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts.

release_games.name: Brine and Brass
release_games.description: Sail a little salvage boat, turn forgotten treasure into better gear, and bring an old harbor back to life. Explore island waters, take on harbor jobs, and uncover keepsakes in a cozy adventure you can play at your own pace.

release_games.name: Lola's Adventures
release_games.description: Everyone Lola meets wants her, and she has no idea why. Follow her on a wild adventure to uncover the mystery, with plenty of sex along the way!

release_games.name: Brain Party
release_games.description: Brain Party is a multiplayer puzzle party game. Compete online with other players for first place by total score. Unlock higher difficulties and beat your personal bests in solo challenges, or take on fresh daily challenges and climb the global leaderboard.

release_games.name: RushMath
release_games.description: RushMath is a single-player arithmetic arcade game against the clock. Solve random problems, build combos and beat your personal best. Correct answers restore time; mistakes take it away. Earn credits and purchase permanent upgrades.

release_games.name: Royal Court
release_games.description: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.

release_games.name: Moonbased
release_games.description: Fuse any two of 23 weapons into 422 absurd, screen-clearing turrets in this chaotic top-down lunar roguelite! Pilot 4 hulls across 4 alien worlds, stack broken upgrades, melt massive bosses and survive escalating swarms to top the weekly leaderboard!

release_games.name: The Coin Keeper : Tidy up !
release_games.description: One dragon sneeze. 6,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.

release_games.name: Onidot: Game of Tag
release_games.description: ひとりでも、最大20人でも。シンプルな見下ろし型鬼ごっこ！ミッションでアイテムを獲得し、狭い視界と足音を頼りに鬼から逃げ切れ！「逃走者」かあるいは「追跡者（鬼）」か、好きな陣営が選べるぞ！友達と同じ部屋に集まって遊ぶモードや、知らない人と対戦するランダムマッチも搭載！オフラインではNPCを相手にした対戦や、クリア条件の達成を目指すステージチャレンジが遊べる！さらにマップ作成機能、キャラクターカスタマイズ機能なども充実！

release_games.name: Master Of Kebab
release_games.description: Run your own kebab business on the night streets of Istanbul. Prepare ingredients, cook different meals, serve customers, manage your supplies, upgrade your shop and deal with unexpected events in this first-person cooking and business simulation.

release_games.name: Keep Farming Aura
release_games.description: Farm Aura and turn every move into momentum. Attract a crowd, build your crew, unlock upgrades and face powerful rivals as you grow from an unknown into an Aura legend in this active 3D incremental game.

release_games.name: Monster Girls of Another World: Pleasure Chronicle
release_games.description: A casual erotic action RPG with fully animated sex scenes and over 200 animated pixel-art CGs! Explore, earn money, and visit monster girl brothels. Write about your encounters and sell your articles to fund your next visit. Enjoy simple one-button combat, fishing, and casino games along the way!

release_games.name: Strip Bubbles: Rich Ladies Club
release_games.description: Enter the exclusive Rich Ladies Club! Challenge four powerful, ultra-wealthy heiresses in addictive bubble-shooter matches: a strict lawyer with forbidden desires, a casino countess, an innocent noblewoman seeking sin, and an oil princess. Master the art of high-society seduction.

release_games.name: Next Orbit
release_games.description: Build your deck, outsmart your enemies, and help Norma repair the Next Orbit in this turn-based card game set in a world where technology and nature collide

release_games.name: Altertum
release_games.description: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.

release_games.name: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
release_games.description: Wizard Jars is a cozy solo and co-op sorting game where you organize 3,240 magical jars in a chaotic apothecary. Put every jar back on its shelf, fulfill magical customer requests, unlock useful upgrades, and restore the apothecary to perfect order

release_games.name: Primal Breakout
release_games.description: You are the first dinosaur to break out of the lab. Fight through fifteen worlds, raise fifteen prehistoric beasts and build a skill tree of 27 abilities – an incremental where a strike at the right moment deals almost double.

release_games.name: Fish Battle Champion
release_games.description: A strategic fishing roguelike autobattler with 'fish deckbuilding'. Catch bizarre fish, discover rare bonuses, collect powerful items and build unexpected synergies. Every night, send your team into the tournament and see if your strategy survives!

release_games.name: The SwordSmith
release_games.description: Forge every blade with your own hands. Build your sword formation, battle demons from all sides, and protect the one who waits for you — a heartwarming wuxia journey of crafting, roguelite runs and auto-battles.

release_games.name: There's a Cat in My PC
release_games.description: A completely free desktop companion pet with no payments, ever! Allergic to cats? You can still adopt! Meet 98 one-of-a-kind cats that drop by every day, right on top of your PC windows, keeping you company without ever getting in the way~

release_games.name: Undealt
release_games.description: Undealt is an idle RPG that lives in the corner of your screen. Four heroes fight on their own while you work or play — you come back to equip the loot, forge better gear, learn skills and collect cards that rewrite the rules of combat. Free to play.

release_games.name: Programmable Theft Action VI
release_games.description: Code the perfect crime — even with Vibe Coding.

release_games.name: Nana's Game Dev Diary
release_games.description: Nana's Game Dev Diary is a relaxing life sim about making games. Join Nana in her cozy little home as she follows her dream, planning each day around development, learning, part-time work, and rest. Enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life with Nana.

release_games.name: Desktop‑LivablePlanet
release_games.description: A soothing little planet for your desktop—farm, fish, and enjoy a leisurely life with your you often find yourself staring blankly at your computer while busy with work and want something that doesn't require mental effort...Welcome to your very own desktop "Livable Planet."

release_games.name: Stadt Land Fluss with friends
release_games.description: Stadt, Land, Fluss für euren nächsten Online-Spieleabend: Ob Stadt, Land, Serienfigur oder Fund im WG-Kühlschrank, wählt klassische Kategorien oder denkt euch eigene aus. Stell dein Wissen auch allein auf die Probe und finde immer neue Begriffe in abwechslungsreichen Spielmodi.

release_games.name: Hentai Furry Bunny 2
release_games.description: A colorful furry anime puzzle game. Match pairs, solve puzzles, unlock new bunny outfits and illustrations, and complete all 48 stages to fill your gallery.

release_games.name: Bustout: Anime Girls
release_games.description: Smash through blocks and strip gorgeous anime women. Bustout is a fast, sexy twist on classic Breakout. Master every ricochet, chase high scores, and let those perfect busts out.

release_games.name: CropKeep
release_games.description: Hold the farm, upgrade your mercenaries, and take down enemies for relics that make you stronger. Even when you fall, the growth you banked stays with you.

release_games.name: Objecipher
release_games.description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

release_games.name: Tick & Tired
release_games.description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

release_games.name: Hentai Tales: Chesty Gyaru Naughty Service
release_games.description: You're an ordinary office worker, crushed by overtime and a boss who never stops. Late one night, in the family restaurant where you always hide from the world, a chesty gyaru part-timer drags you into the stockroom and locks the door.

release_games.name: Idle Legend
release_games.description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

release_games.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
release_games.description: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

release_games.name: Below The Blades
release_games.description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

release_games.name: Hit or Die
release_games.description: Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors, dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing wins.

release_games.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
release_games.description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.

release_games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
release_games.description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

release_games.name: TapTrapGrow
release_games.description: Light up a pest-filled garden, send turtle shells ricocheting and protect your cakes. Turn short hunts into permanent upgrades and elemental chain reactions in this arcade incremental game, then take on a six-boss finale.

release_games.name: Jump Bald
release_games.description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

release_games.name: ALL EYES ON ME
release_games.description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.

release_games.name: Desktop Ball
release_games.description: A little ball that lives on top of your desktop and can blow it up, zap it, flood it, haunt it, or grow a garden all over it. Fidget with it through meetings, queues and compiles, and when you're done, it gets out of the way. Seven weird balls, and every one of them beats doomscrolling.

release_games.name: Wild Wheels
release_games.description: Wild Wheels is a fast and frantic kart racer where cute animals play dirty. Pick your racer, hit the track, dodge hazards, grab ridiculous power-ups, and do whatever it takes to reach the checkered flag first.

release_games.name: ChromaFlow
release_games.description: Build a factory powered by color. Extract red, green, and blue, route them through conveyor networks, and mix them into an expanding spectrum. Fulfil requests for the Chroma Core, unlock new technology, and optimize every production line.

release_games.name: Sexy Vacation
release_games.description: A story-rich adult visual novel where your choices shape your summer. Choose your name, escape to a beautiful seaside town, and build intimate connections with Aria and Maya. Every decision matters—from sunlit adventures to private moments after dark.

release_games.name: Guttering Light
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

release_games.name: WDR:window rush
release_games.description: Ultimate mini idle tower defense! Cute pixel heroes are waiting to join you in defending against data invasions – right inside your desktop popups. Use an extensive variety of tower combinations and your brilliant tactical setups to fend off the boredom of everyday life!

release_games.name: Inkturn
release_games.description: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

release_games.name: The Studio - Indie Grind
release_games.description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.

release_games.name: Grazed - Incremental Arcade
release_games.description: Every kill means brushing past death. Grazed is a skill-based incremental arcade game: graze enemies with your blades, build your combo, and ignite absurd powers. Runs last seconds to minutes. Beat your score, upgrade, repeat.

release_games.name: Toybox Tactics
release_games.description: Enter a block-sized world and conquer the world by defending your towers in this colorful strategy game!

release_games.name: From Zero: Idle Factory
release_games.description: Start with one machine and grow across five factories in this idle/incremental game. Build production chains, research better parts and reinvest your profits. Find the bottleneck, choose your next upgrade and work toward a final goal.

release_games.name: Moon Swarm
release_games.description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

release_games.name: Wings of Beyond
release_games.description: Battle through hordes of enemies in intense space combat! Conquer 30 challenging stages, explore 3 unique galactic systems, upgrade your ship, and unlock over 30 exclusive skins as you test your reflexes and strategy in fast-paced arcade action.

release_games.name: Starfall
release_games.description: You play a ship in the void of space that must survive an increasing horde of enemies. As you progress you level up your abilities. Can you survive long enough from the horde of attacks?

release_games.name: Death Row
release_games.description: You are sentenced to death in the torture chamber! To stop the approaching saw, you must solve 2-player co-op or 4-player 2v2 competitive asymmetric puzzles. As the silent guide and the circuit solver, race against time and escape execution!

release_games.name: ASAGE
release_games.description: A short hand-drawn adventure set in a serene blue-green forest. The only thing you can do on the world map is pray. Meet the forest's residents and complete a traditional Japanese breakfast known as Asage through a series of charming, slightly strange minigames.

release_games.name: One Gun Army
release_games.description: One gun to conquer the universe. Every trigger squeeze, mag dump, and slam on the bolt release inches you closer and closer to full domination in this incremental idler.

release_games.name: FAKE ME
release_games.description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

release_games.name: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash
release_games.description: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game starring girls from different school clubs, each with unique abilities. Play online (beta, full version only), locally with a friend, or against the CPU. Use six shot types, SP Shots, and SP Skills in Story Mode and Versus!

release_games.name: Sweet Sailor 2
release_games.description: Sweet Sailor 2 - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around sailors. Experience the daily lives of five pretty and adorable sailor girls at the dock or on their ships, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

release_games.name: HamYam
release_games.description: A fast-paced, competitive 2D platform racing game of hamsters competing through beautiful dream world tracks!

release_games.name: Dawnheart Keepers
release_games.description: Hold the line across a voice-acted 21-mission campaign, or begin a Long Dawn run: a generated board, no gold, and a card draft after every wave. Ten spires, 41 foes, online co-op for up to 9 Keepers, 6v6 Rival Keeps, and a level editor with Workshop. Fully voiced in English and Hebrew.

release_games.name: My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair
release_games.description: A temporary backstage job becomes a dangerous affair with Mira, a charismatic mime who speaks most through silence. Help her build a show, hide your secret, make difficult choices, and unlock 5 endings in this adult visual novel.

release_games.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist
release_games.description: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!

release_games.name: Idle of the Dead
release_games.description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

release_games.name: Dungeon Node
release_games.description: Dungeon Node is an incremental roguelike where you grow stronger by battling endless waves of enemies. Invest in skill nodes to recruit mercenaries and unlock new abilities. From forests to the depths of hell, stronger enemies and new challenges await as you venture deeper.

release_games.name: Take a Joke
release_games.description: Family game night just got hilariously weird. Take a Joke is a fill-in-the-blank party game where everyone takes a turn being the punchline — because your names go right into the cards. Runs on your TV; everyone else plays from the phone in their pocket. 3–8 players.

release_games.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
release_games.description: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

release_games.name: 疾风群侠传
release_games.description: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。

release_games.name: Protocell
release_games.description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

release_games.name: Purrfect Beats
release_games.description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

release_games.name: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
release_games.description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

release_games.name: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun
release_games.description: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun is a wuxia action roguelike in ink-wash style. Choose your sect, enter the heavenly tribulation, clear linked rooms, and stack secret manuals with Qiankun relics into brutal melee combos. Every run reshapes your build—fight through mist and ink, and survive.

release_games.name: Frontier Tale
release_games.description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

release_games.name: Quarterheart
release_games.description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

release_games.name: Fox Stamps
release_games.description: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

release_games.name: Campfire Battles
release_games.description: An auto-battler roguelike where every foe is another player's camp. Draft units, spells, and powers from the shop, arrange them for game-breaking synergies, and outposition your opponent to claim the win.

release_games.name: SPUM TD
release_games.description: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match element and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate lineup!

release_games.name: Deadly Match
release_games.description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

release_games.name: Your Sweet Little Kitty
release_games.description: Your cozy desktop companion! This adorable cat hangs out on your screen while you work or study, gently reminding you to hydrate and take breaks. Feed it to unlock cute animations and level up your bond. Ready to be the ultimate cat servant?

release_games.name: Brick Mayhem
release_games.description: A physics-based autobattler where tiny plastic warriors battle across fully destructible fortresses. Customize your army, unleash explosive sieges, and enjoy chaotic brick-filled destruction.

release_games.name: Faraday Corridors
release_games.description: A brain-teasing puzzle game with a speedrun twist. Flip switches, rotate cells and guide your pawns to the exit. Then do it again, but faster.

release_games.name: Feypath
release_games.description: Feypath is a single button precision platformer for those that like punishing gameplay. Save the princess and uncover the secrets of the Demon Kingdom by jumping to the top of the world!

release_games.name: Patience Balls
release_games.description: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 100 hand-crafted levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, create custom puzzles with the Level Editor, and climb global leaderboards.

release_games.name: CHAIN NOVA
release_games.description: A quick dopamine hit while your other game loads. Fire one NOVA and hundreds of enemies chain-pop like dominoes as BASE × MULT explode. Just move and detonate. 1-2 minute DOPAGAKI MODE runs, 3 stages and 3 bosses, and Endless. Auto-pauses when you tab away and resumes where you left off.

release_games.name: HANDS OVER
release_games.description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

release_games.name: Turnflower
release_games.description: Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects! With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.

release_games.name: Singularity Echoes
release_games.description: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.

release_games.name: Vroomity Loops
release_games.description: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout common sense goes out the window.

release_games.name: Keystones: Foundations
release_games.description: A calm 3D puzzle game about a little slime and some very heavy stones. Grab, slide, rotate and tumble pieces until the right face lands in the right place. 500 puzzles: every level comes in five difficulties, from gentle to brutal.

release_games.name: Ascend6
release_games.description: Combine 2 card games in 1 roguelike! Boost combat damage with equips, or ramp up hand scores with skills. 3 classes to choose from.

release_games.name: Super Slime
release_games.description: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.

release_games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
release_games.description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

release_games.name: Weimiao Survivor
release_games.description: A pixel-art survival tower defense game with satisfying combat and flexible strategy. Unlock higher-level weapons and climb to the top of the leaderboard with a higher score!

release_games.name: Desktop Claw Master
release_games.description: Graboo is the shyest claw machine in the world. Graboo quietly picks up doll friends from the corner of the screen while you're working or enjoying games. Give warm friends to Graboo, a loner!

release_games.name: Dusteroids
release_games.description: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

release_games.name: MillionCube
release_games.description: Million Cube is a maze exploration game with multiplayer for up to 30 players. Find the one correct room among up to a million rooms by following clues hidden in the writing on the doors and the surrounding scenery!

release_games.name: Airspace Master
release_games.description: Control both skies and ground in a complete ATC experience. Manage arrivals, departures, and taxi operations while maintaining Operational Integrity. Dynamic weather, a day/night cycle, multiple airports, and unique challenges.

release_games.name: TeamChess
release_games.description: Chess meets teamwork. Form a team, each propose a move, and let Stockfish pick the best one. One brilliant idea from any teammate can turn the game. No servers — just pure peer-to-peer play.

release_games.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum
release_games.description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

release_games.name: Slotbound
release_games.description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

release_games.name: Beat Bots
release_games.description: A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots! Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound

release_games.name: Lorenium Orbit
release_games.description: Lorenium Orbit is a fast-paced 2D team-based space combat arena where players pilot specialized warships, customize loadouts, and battle in tactical 7v7 matches. Master momentum-based flight, precision aiming, and coordinated fleet strategy to dominate orbit.

release_games.name: Click vs X: Popup Ad Hell - 画面いっぱいの嫌がらせ -
release_games.description: All you wanted was to watch a video, but bad popup ads are taking over your screen! Chase down escaping 'X' buttons with millisecond precision in this 90s OS desktop survival action. A 100% fixed, muscle-memory challenge. Speedrun all 50 chaotic stages and conquer the global leaderboard!

release_games.name: Potted Pets
release_games.description: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!

release_games.name: Gift Stream: Sorting & Delivery Simulator
release_games.description: Gift Stream Sorting & Delivery Simulator is a logistics management simulator where gifts constantly arrive through a mysterious portal. Inspect, sort, and ship them efficiently while upgrading machines and expanding your warehouse to handle an ever-growing delivery stream.

release_games.name: InCowMental
release_games.description: InCowMental is a cute and colorful tiny incremental game where you collect milk from your cows to sell it and make cheese. Upgrade your farm, and between upgrades, play mini-games to boost your production and sales!

release_games.name: Bottled by Bears
release_games.description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

release_games.name: Rolls and Dungeons
release_games.description: An incremental game about casinos and dungeons! Assemble a team of debtor-heroes, clear dungeons, hoard chips, and spin the slot machine in combat to defeat monsters and bosses. Level up your luck, hunt for loot and artifacts, unlock new dungeon levels – the ultimate jackpot awaits at the very end!

release_games.name: Little Mess: Tidy a toyshop
release_games.description: A toy shop has been turned upside down, and it's up to you to put every last toy back where it belongs. Sort, box and shelve thousands of toys in a cozy, hand-painted first-person tidying game. Fix the signs, earn clever upgrades, and bring the shop back to life.

release_games.name: Draconite
release_games.description: Draconite is a Furry-themed side-scrolling adventure game focused on exploration and storytelling. As a security team member of the Draconite Research Institute, you'll carry out security duties during the summit and gradually uncover the turbulent undercurrents hidden beneath the calm facade.

release_games.name: Shelf-Made Tycoon
release_games.description: A cozy tycoon game about growing a tiny warehouse into a logistics empire. Land bigger deals until trucks, trains and ships bring work to your door. When money gets tight, a crime syndicate pays big for a few unmarked crates. Just hope the driver isn't an undercover cop.

release_games.name: Sexy Santa Girls 2
release_games.description: Sexy Santa Girls 2 is a festive find-the-differences game with beautiful girls and cozy Christmas vibes. Carefully compare two similar images and spot hidden details in outfits, poses, decorations, and backgrounds at a relaxed, enjoyable pace.

release_games.name: Hex-a-Decimal
release_games.description: Hex-a-Decimal is an automation puzzle game on a hexagon grid. Set up lines of conveyors, pausers, sensors, and various other components to get signals to where they need to go. It's a challenging game that anyone can pick up, but the question is: how far will YOUR puzzle solving skills take you?

release_games.name: hop to bunny restaurant!
release_games.description: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!

release_games.name: Doom Keeper
release_games.description: A fast-paced arena action roguelike about mercenaries fighting on the edge of the galaxy. Choose your hero, battle hordes of aliens, create powerful builds, and turn your body into the ultimate weapon with combat implants.

release_games.name: TowerBits8
release_games.description: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.

release_games.name: 100 Kingdom Cats
release_games.description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

release_games.name: Vitavania
release_games.description: 🍂The most vibrant Metroidvania about a catgirl! Sandbox elements, divinity, and mysticism!

release_games.name: ICU Anomaly
release_games.description: Ride a hospital elevator through an abandoned ICU. On every floor, search the ward for anomalies. Nothing wrong? Go up. Something off? Go down. One wrong call sends you back to floor 1. Reach floor 13 to escape, if Lucy lets you.

release_games.name: Project: Home!
release_games.description: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.

release_games.name: Badass Brigade
release_games.description: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

release_games.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
release_games.description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

release_games.name: Spin Tactics
release_games.description: A roguelike strategy game inside a slot machine. Pick your Companions, set the order they fire in, change your symbols with Gems, and build an engine that keeps growing, until the machine is wonderfully broken and the bosses can’t keep up. No real-money gambling.

release_games.name: Explosiovania
release_games.description: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

release_games.name: Coffee Buns
release_games.description: Coffee Buns is a transformation visual novel set in the world of Mice Tea. Leonardo Bianco is a barista getting used to living in a world where a magical tea can turn you into a furry, and when he gets his own chance to try it he's thrust into an erotic, gender-bending journey of self-discovery.

release_games.name: Blood Sword
release_games.description: An ancient evil returns. A sword lost to legend. A party bound by fate. Forge your legacy in a story-rich RPG of turn-based combat and branching choices, inspired by the classic Blood Sword saga.

release_games.name: Tiny Trawler
release_games.description: A cozy top-down fishing game set on the Norwegian coast. Start with a handline on the dock, then work your way up to your own fleet – from a little dinghy to a shrimp trawler. Chase 55 species, follow the rumours, and sail home under lantern light.

release_games.name: ArenaOfNature
release_games.description: What happend at ＂ArenaOfNature＂？

release_games.name: Delve Survivors
release_games.description: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

release_games.name: Satelital
release_games.description: A short rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

release_games.name: Fat Goblins
release_games.description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

release_games.name: Overhours
release_games.description: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!

release_games.name: Stream Slayers
release_games.description: Turn your Twitch chat into a party in Stream Slayers! Choose from 6 unique classes, level up, unlock powerful abilities, and work together to defeat increasingly powerful bosses. Your chat fights.

release_games.name: Warithmetic
release_games.description: Build armies from equations in a real-time factory-building auto battler. Add, multiply, divide, and combine numbers into melee, ranged, and healer units that advance and fight automatically. Refine your production against adaptive AI or battle online with up to six players.

release_games.name: Beware of Ants
release_games.description: You're an ant, the first worker hatched in a formicarium on somebody's desk, so you lay pheromone trails, grow the colony and walk your queen across the whole house and out through the veranda drain, past the homeowner's tweezers, bug spray, robot vacuum and feet. Outside there's a toad.

release_games.name: Ghosts Cast No Shadow
release_games.description: In this cozy deduction game you keep a village gate at night in Joseon-era Korea, and some who knock are yogoe, monsters of Korean folktales in human guise. Raise a lantern, check the registry and ask questions, then let the humans in and seal the yogoe in a gourd with a talisman. Ten nights a run.

release_games.name: MARK IT
release_games.description: Draw marks on a blank white jigsaw. Your own clues are the only way to put it back together! But as the levels go on, your marks may be erased, copied, flipped, rotated and more, so plan ahead and make sure they still give you the clues you need.

release_games.name: Cast & Found
release_games.description: A cozy fishing trip across Europe. Follow your grandmother's journal from a Swiss lake to Marseille, Geiranger and a Greek island: cast, reel, sell the catch, talk to the locals, decorate your cabin, and bring the pug. No fail states, no clock. Just the next cast.

release_games.name: Rocky Castle
release_games.description: Tiny heroes. Giant towers. Epic falls! Choose your favorite adorable blocky pet and climb crazy spiral castles packed with deadly traps, rolling boulders, explosive surprises, and hilarious challenges. Jump, dodge, and conquer the tower. How high can you climb?

release_games.name: Drift: Beyond Grip
release_games.description: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.

release_games.name: Stickanza : A Stickman Story
release_games.description: Everything you draw comes to life! Draw weapons, vehicles, animals, and even dragons, and watch your creations interact with the world! Overcome obstacles, explore an open world, visit cities, complete quests, and uncover clues to reunite a stickman with his lost family.

release_games.name: Dice & Fate Duel
release_games.description: Roll dice, build combos, and bend fate in a single-player turn-based dice-card duel. 30 cards, distinct AI opponents, and a heavy dose of RNG. Please note before buying: luck matters, the difficulty is high, and even good decisions can lose to the dice.

release_games.name: inFADErs
release_games.description: inFADErs is a barbershop simulator where every hair on your customer's head is real. Thousands of strands grow, fall, flop when wet and stand up when dry, and every one of them is judged when the cut is done.

release_games.name: MATHINK
release_games.description: MATHINK is a single-player math game on the pages of a hand-drawn notebook. Solve changing problems, choose bonus cards, and push for a new personal best. Pick one of three starting difficulties and work your way from simple arithmetic to tougher challenges.

release_games.name: Hanzen: A Chinese Word Journey
release_games.description: Discover the joy of learning Chinese: connect characters into words across 30 ink-wash themes, planned to grow to 100. Every word includes pinyin, English meaning, and audio. The interface stays in Chinese for immersion - hover any button for an English tip. Zen Mode or 3-minute Challenge.

release_games.name: Terminal Fall
release_games.description: Your engine dies over an autumn forest at sunset. You survive the crash, but all that's left is rain, darkness and something waiting at the edge of your flashlight beam. Find fuel, start the generator and reach the rangers before the night swallows you. A short horror, about an hour long.

release_games.name: Reperta
release_games.description: An idle collecting game where no two finds are alike. Pick a world, press EXPLORE, and every artifact comes out with its own rarity, finish, preservation and a serial number counted across the whole server. 105 artifacts, 8 finishes, 16 worlds and a player Market. Any roll can be the one.

release_games.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
release_games.description: The ocean is drowning in plastic. Steer your boat, scoop up trash, sell at port and grow from a 3.6 m Skiff to a 70 m Megascoop with over 40 boats in your fleet. Play solo or in a crew of up to 4 online, and clean it all up until the sea turns turquoise again.

release_games.name: 想成为股票交易大师
release_games.description: After every closing bell, the game reveals who fleeced you today and how. A stock-trading roguelite life sim: read the tape, dodge your boss, tell rumors from news, fend off scams, build your toolkit, and survive quarterly life checks. Simplified Chinese only.

release_games.name: Wrestle Bounce Online
release_games.description: Hold. Release. BONK! A one-button ragdoll physics wrestling game where the first head to hit the mat loses. Duel a friend on one keyboard, beat the AI, win tournaments or take on real players online for coin prizes. Easy to learn, impossible to play without laughing.

release_games.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock
release_games.description: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.

release_games.name: The Hidden Lot: Bid. Salvage. Restore.
release_games.description: A single-player storage auction and restoration sim. Win sealed lockers with a flashlight, a UV lamp and a hunch, outbid three rivals, tear them apart in a cut-away view, spot the fakes, and fill your own museum with 2,000+ collectibles.

release_games.name: Voxmons
release_games.description: A cozy voxel creature collector. Hatch and fuse 187 Voxmons, free the guardians of four floating worlds, and send your squad farming while you're away. Skate for records, duel in the 3D Arena, trade rare finds on the Steam Community Market. Free to play, no ads.

release_games.name: FatInfantry
release_games.description: Battle the vegetable army that kidnapped the chefs! FatInfantry is a 2D action platformer where eating makes you stronger. Shoot in any direction, land belly strikes, swing a chained fork and cross dangerous terrain. Turn every kilo gained into your own fighting style.

release_games.name: Island Crusade
release_games.description: Click monsters, recruit knights and free 100 pixel-art islands. When the sky splits, a second army fights in the Underside, a blood-soaked mirror of the kingdom, alongside your crusade. Timed bosses, a celestial sword, daily challenges and two worlds.

release_games.name: RAYBREAKER
release_games.description: A neon twin-stick shooter with the loot heart of an action RPG. Burn down a glowing fuse in 5 to 8 minute runs, read the swarm, break its bosses and bring home gear that rewrites your build. Six bands of a shattered spectrum, solo or in co-op for two, side by side or online.

release_games.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing
release_games.description: A free fishing game made by one guy who has been making fishing games since 2008. Catch 100+ weird fish for the fridge door, work your way up from an Oak Branch to the Necro-pole, win the weekly derbies, beat real players 1v1, and tune the deck radio: 4 stations, DJs and 160+ original songs.

release_games.name: We Have a Sheep Problem
release_games.description: Every sheep on the farm has escaped from its stand. Catch them, carry them home and put each one back in its own spot. Hats, costumes, a whole meadow of runaways and a few silly tools to help. A cosy, woolly tidy up game.

release_games.name: OCDust: One Room. Every Last Speck. One Way Out.
release_games.description: You woke up in a room full of dust. The only way out is to clean it all. All one million specks.

release_games.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up
release_games.description: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!

release_games.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain
release_games.description: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car.

release_games.name: Rummage Row
release_games.description: Open your own stall at the flea market. Buy cheap from the secondhand dealer, set out your goods, name your price and haggle with every customer. Grow your reputation, trade with neighboring sellers and find the pieces your story customers are hunting for. A warm, relaxing secondhand business game.

release_games.name: 덤블링 던전 (TumblingDungeon)
release_games.description: A third-person physics roguelike where you aim the blade yourself. Swing, roll and shove your way through 27 zones and nine bosses, build your run from 54 relics (14 of them unlocked at the Altar), and take on pacts that raise the risk and the reward.

release_games.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket
release_games.description: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?

release_games.name: Eerie Harvest
release_games.description: Embrace the quiet farm atmosphere, while waiting for your pumpkin veins to grow monstrous (or tiny) pumpkins. Rule the contest with these and collect unique pumpkin variations along your journey.

release_games.name: Fish Market Tidy Up!
release_games.description: A squall has scattered the morning catch across an old harbour fish market. Put every fish back in its crate: each one you sort plays a note, every full crate sings its tune. A cozy first-person tidying game with a living hall, hidden curiosities and upgrades.

release_games.name: Lewd Life
release_games.description: Sneak past the guards, use the map gimmicks, and open every locked door. 14 beauties are waiting on the other side — with an animated scene to match. 30 stages. 30 adult animations.

release_games.name: Punch Riot
release_games.description: A first-person party brawler for up to 20 players! Punch rivals out of crumbling arenas or launch them into goals with wacky weapons. Play every mode solo against AI, or invite Steam friends. Multiplayer starts with 2 human players, with AI filling empty slots.

release_games.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
release_games.description: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

release_games.name: YASUKE CHRONICLES
release_games.description: A samurai escapes Honno-ji—and ends up fighting beside Napoleon. Cut through crowds, parry bosses, and hunt for your next weapon in this 3D action RPG. Forge up to five War Sigils into your favorite blade. This revolution has an ending the history books never recorded.

release_games.name: Bullet Glory
release_games.description: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

release_games.name: Car Parkour 4 Together
release_games.description: Team up with up to 3 players and tackle parkour courses in a town swallowed by water! Take on the Sunken Bloom and Drowned Wastes maps, overcome obstacles, create chaos with your cars, and choose between collision-free or collision-enabled gameplay with the Immunity feature!

release_games.name: The Crime Archive
release_games.description: A story-driven noir detective game. Search crime scenes, crack evidence puzzles, interrogate suspects, and accuse the killer. Six cases, from a locked office to a lighthouse. Get it wrong, and the killer walks free.

release_games.name: Slay the Tire
release_games.description: Welcome to the largest roguelike deckbuilder ever made. Ride four outlaws down the world's great roads, from Monument Valley to the Tokaido, the Scottish Highlands and the pyramids of Giza, and fight every car, truck and creature that wants you off the road, one card at a time.

release_games.name: ATELIER BLOCKS
release_games.description: ATELIER BLOCKS is a falling-block puzzle game built around customization, creation, and multiple ways to play. It features 18 single-player rule sets, nine AI battle rule sets, cute minigames, and five Creation Studios.

release_games.name: Flux Fall
release_games.description: Idle pinball meets pachinko in Flux Fall. Drop balls through a glowing peg cascade, use your flippers to keep them in play, and hit ramps to build bigger chains and more coins. Level up every part of the board, upgrade your automation, and keep earning while you're away.

release_games.name: Cuby Clicker
release_games.description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

release_games.name: Apex Armada
release_games.description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

release_games.name: Boing Fight
release_games.description: A physics party brawler for 2–4 players on one screen. Grab weapons falling from the sky, bounce around 150 arenas full of saws, portals and trapdoors, and be the last Boing standing. Bots fill empty seats; play locally, on LAN or online.

release_games.name: Tavern Aftermath
release_games.description: Royal soldiers ransacked your late father's tavern. Put 2,500 scattered things back where they belong, earn helpful abilities, and follow a hidden mage's notes to the secret the soldiers were after. A cozy first-person tidying game with no timers and no pressure.

release_games.name: Bean in a Ball Pit
release_games.description: A handful of beans are hiding under a ridiculous number of balls. Wade into a colorful physics pit, sink balls for cash, and build a gloriously excessive cleanup operation with belts, cannons, bots, cranes and wind rings. Somewhere underneath it all, your beans are waiting.

release_games.name: Shelves Full of Figures
release_games.description: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

release_games.name: Just Farm
release_games.description: Farming games can be complicated. This one isn’t. No empire to manage, no endless chores, no agricultural career waiting for you. Just relax, get in the tractor, and farm.

release_games.name: Victory's Grave: Death Before Dismount
release_games.description: Top-down arcade tank shooter. Plant mines, battle Soviet armor, and defend your flag in a destructible Eastern European city.

release_games.name: Ace of Jianghu
release_games.description: Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another. A story-driven wuxia card RPG: four sects — Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult — and twelve roads. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts.

release_games.name: RPM: Next Drag Racing Simulator
release_games.description: Rev up, conquer cities, and rule the streets in RPM: Next drag racing simulator!

release_games.name: Chaos Table
release_games.description: A social deduction party game for 6–10 players, with bots to fill empty seats. Bluff, vote and play cards as secret roles change mid-game. Even after death, you can keep stirring up trouble as a ghost.

release_games.name: Vesper Drift
release_games.description: Reclaim the five Singularities in this Asteroids-inspired roguelite. Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op, destroy asteroids, combine weapons, fusions and passive abilities, and fight across 150 combat zones on 30 planets spread over 5 star systems.

release_games.name: Loadpath
release_games.description: LOADPATH is a physics-driven demolition game about finding the supports that matter. Cut through industrial structures, trigger massive collapses, recover Salvage, upgrade your demolition rig and descend deeper through seven increasingly dangerous sites.

release_games.name: Tidyspell
release_games.description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

release_games.name: PoetryDefense
release_games.description: Poetry Defense blends classical Chinese poetry with tower defense. Lead poets like Li Bai, Du Fu, and Su Shi against insect swarms, answer verse challenges to trigger skills, study ancient texts, unlock poems, and light up poet constellations in your own starry sky.

release_games.name: TaskBarStudio
release_games.description: Grow a small game studio in the corner of your desktop. Hire developers, build a team, and create and release games. Keep the game running and close the main window: development continues while you get on with other tasks. Use reviews and sales to shape your next project.

release_games.name: Leonard Sibelius
release_games.description: I'm 71. I spent forty years in cubicles building software systems that all were retired. Use of AI was forbidden. This is my memoir, and I built it with AI. Earn AI powers from five dancing AI agents, watch them wrestle, race go-karts, play chess and Go, and create movies about dancing.

release_games.name: The Halls Remain
release_games.description: Restore power, decode messages, and search for a missing worker in corridors that refuse to end. A first-person puzzle horror game where records, routes, and the things watching you cannot be trusted. Play on screen or in optional VR.

release_games.name: NAQOO: BOLTFIRE
release_games.description: Fast-paced local arena shooter for 2–4 players on one screen. Shoot, set traps, capture automated turrets, and blow up explosive barrels. Destructible arenas and customizable rules keep every match different, with quick rematches, petty tricks, instant karma, and plenty of laughs.

release_games.name: Sudoku Kingdom
release_games.description: Beyond the classic 9×9: 22 Sudoku modes and tens of thousands of puzzles, including Killer, Thermometer, Arrow, Jigsaw, Circular, Triangle, Snowflake and Cube boards. Multiple difficulties, notes, undo and hints. One purchase—no ads, energy or microtransactions.

release_games.name: Engagement
release_games.description: Command a capital ship alone or up to 4 players co-op and hold the Belt of Ashes against the Hollow and more until relief arrives. Every upgrade is a turret bolted to a hardpoint you can see, your escorts you recruit keep their names and kills, and every fight has variety to make it new.

release_games.name: Pull My Finger
release_games.description: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...

release_games.name: The Keyless: Forbidden Door
release_games.description: The Keyless: Forbidden Door is a dreamlike and surreal journey, witness bizarre metaphorical and surreal scenes in a world that changes shape as you overcome simple challenges.

release_games.name: Teddy Store: Tidy Up
