release_games.description: A cozy first-person sorting game. 2,100 plush teddy bears of 210 different kinds are scattered all over a toy store: ten of each, and no two rows alike. Sort them onto the right shelves and bring the store back to order. 4 to 10 hours to tidy it all.

release_games.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
release_games.description: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.

release_games.name: TERRITORY SCRAMBLE
release_games.description: Step, surround, conquer! Claim hexagonal tiles by stepping on them, then enclose areas to capture them at once. Fight for bases and cannons with weapons and items in fast-paced, top-down territory battles. Play online with up to 16 players across 2-4 teams, or take on bots.

release_games.name: Tidy Up: Electronic Store Simulator
release_games.description: Bring order to a chaotic electronics store! Pick up misplaced gadgets, find where every item belongs, organize shelves and displays, earn rewards, upgrade your abilities, and transform a messy store into a perfectly organized space.

release_games.name: Snakium
release_games.description: Built with a laser focus on tight mechanics and a scalable challenge, Snakium strips away modern gaming bloat to focus entirely on what makes arcade games great: satisfying, escalating difficulty. It is easy to pick up, incredibly hard to master, and dangerously addictive.

release_games.name: Flash Freeze
release_games.description: A battle of wits on two boards. Trap wandering blobs in ice, clear the lines they're frozen in, and earn water pieces that pour into nearby crevices. Every line you clear while the water flows lands on your opponent's board.

release_games.name: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad
release_games.description: A desktop idle RPG where monsters battle on their own while you work or study! Recruit a colorful cast of monsters, build your own squad, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans.

release_games.name: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Video Game Store!
release_games.description: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Game Store! — Sort games, consoles, and accessories in a retro game store. Restore messy shelves, unlock useful upgrades, and enjoy turning chaos into perfect order.

release_games.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
release_games.description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

release_games.name: Prospect
release_games.description: Prospect is a mining roguelike where you carve through the depths of the mines on a perilous journey towards the world above. Vanquish your foes, find mythical artifacts, and forge your own path with your trusty pickaxe. Will you be the first dwarf to ever reach the surface?

release_games.name: Siegecrawler
release_games.description: Load your crew onto a rumbling siege engine and smash through physics-driven castle walls! Battles run themselves — you steer the tide with spells, three war horns, and perfectly timed ram strikes. Pick a commander, swear an oath, equip skills: every run builds different. 30 stages, then Endless.

release_games.name: Journey TD
release_games.description: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

release_games.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
release_games.description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

release_games.name: Memento Resonance
release_games.description: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

release_games.name: Keepwatch: Idle Kingdom RPG
release_games.description: A hero who lives above your taskbar. Keepwatch is an idle auto-battler RPG that quietly runs on your desktop — build your camp, gear up your one and only hero, and let them fight while you get back to work.

release_games.name: Futa Paradise Resort
release_games.description: Inherit a crumbling island resort — and the five gorgeous staff who refuse to let it die. Rebuild the business, outplay a corporate shark, and fall for one of them in this fully voiced adult visual novel with animated scenes. One resort. Five hearts. You can only choose one.

release_games.name: Ricochet Witch
release_games.description: You don't aim freely. The reticle swings on its own, and only one bolt can be in play. Wait for the angle, fire, and turn a single ricochet into a chain of kills. A one-button score-attack shooter: Normal runs take about five to seven minutes, Endless never stops.

release_games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
release_games.description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

release_games.name: Fakin It XL
release_games.description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

release_games.name: Helion Conflict
release_games.description: Real-time strategy stripped down to decision-making: every factory builds endlessly – you decide where the ships fly and redirect them in mid-flight. Up to eight players online, with cross-platform play across Windows, Mac and PlayStation®5. Minutes, not hours.

release_games.name: HOPIATE
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about day trading stocks in a simulated market. Build a deck of edges, trade a tape that moves in real time, clear the week’s target. Blow the account and the evaluation fee was non-refundable. Your account manager is very supportive. He’s paid on volume.

release_games.name: Active Immunity
release_games.description: A twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite fought inside the human body. Pilot an immune cell through escalating waves of pathogens, dodge dense bullet patterns, and stack upgrades into synergies that rewrite your build. Choose how each outbreak mutates, then push a run into endless.

release_games.name: MUTARIUM: Mutant Aquarium Defense
release_games.description: Feed them and they mutate. Overfeed them and they turn on you. Mix MEAT, GLOW and ORE to grow your fish into adorable little horrors, then let them fight the failed experiments breaking into your tank. You never control a unit — what you feed is the whole strategy.

release_games.name: A BILLION GOLD DEBT
release_games.description: Grow your settlement, automate production, explore the surrounding lands, and trade with your neighbors to repay a debt of 1 BILLION gold!

release_games.name: Aviator: Airline Empire
release_games.description: Build a global airline empire from the dawn of the Jet Age into the future. Connect 120+ cities on an interactive world map, command iconic aircraft, and outsmart rivals in this turn-based strategy sim. Features solo campaigns, an Open Skies sandbox, and 2–4 player local hot-seat multiplayer.

release_games.name: Flock Fight
release_games.description: A minimalist couch fighting game with a twist: you are a flock of health units. Balance offense and defense as you use weapons to survive quick match ups online or locally.

release_games.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
release_games.description: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your in game laptop.

release_games.name: Become Blackhole
release_games.description: A space incremental game where you start as a speck of dust. Smash celestial bodies and absorb their fragments to gain mass. Grow from an asteroid into a moon, a planet, a star, and finally a black hole.

release_games.name: Pixel Worker
release_games.description: Pixel Worker is a pixel-art work-life simulation where you take jobs, earn money, appraise gear, raise pets, mine, fish, cut jade, trade stocks, and play casino mini-games as you build your own path through a lively city.

release_games.name: The Rouge Casino
release_games.description: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

release_games.name: Campus Clash
release_games.description: A free-to-play card battler where five rival campus cliques settle every argument with cards. Pick one of 15 Leaders, build a deck from 242 cards and outplay the AI, your friends and ranked rivals in fast, tactical duels. Every card can be earned just by playing.

release_games.name: Arsmagia
release_games.description: This is a fresh take on the action genre that fuses shooting mechanics with math puzzles. Spotting the weak points of approaching enemies requires quick and accurate calculations. Solve equations to create openings for attacks, defeat your foes, and aim for a high score.

release_games.name: Passed by Censor
release_games.description: The letters between two pen-pals who have never met cross your censor's desk behind a nameless front. Their romance exists only on paper, so a line you strike is gone from it for good. Partway through, a letter answers a question you only asked in your head. A melancholy epistolary romance.

release_games.name: More Than  A Woman - Season 1
release_games.description: An emotionally charged kinetic visual novel about Hana, an aspiring actress whose relationships and career are slipping through her fingers - until a sudden transformation into a futanari throws her life into chaos and forces her to confront everything she thought she knew.

release_games.name: Purrtopia: Desktop Cat
release_games.description: A cozy pixel cat companion for your desktop: it lives on top of your windows while you work or study. Feed it, play with it, dress it up, and watch its character emerge: it remembers your care, sulks if woken, and hunts its toys.

release_games.name: Bottle Flip Inc
release_games.description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

release_games.name: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
release_games.description: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades across 8 playable fighters, refine solo builds, cut through 35 story chapters, climb Kimon Renrou, and challenge post-story bosses.

release_games.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
release_games.description: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!

release_games.name: Blackbriar Crypt
release_games.description: Lead three doomed mercenaries through a plague-haunted roguelite. Loot drops as items you physically fit into 4x4 packs. What touches what unlocks combos, curses, fire, poison, and the tactics you need to survive.

release_games.name: Chichi's Desktop Journey
release_games.description: Welcome to chichi’s world! Chichi is a little mouse with big travel dreams and just one piece of luggage: a ball! Keep chichi company while you work or study, play together, try new outfits and skins, or go online with friends and bring your mice together on your desktops.

release_games.name: Cake & Bake
release_games.description: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

release_games.name: The Last Spire 2
release_games.description: Upgrade, evolve, and mutate powerful spells as you defend the Last Spire in this strategic incremental tower defense with endless progression and customizable spell loadouts.

release_games.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
release_games.description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

release_games.name: Observer's Mobius
release_games.description: Survive inside a sealed cube. Every action you take is observed by AI observers, and their judgment decides the next punishment or blessing.

release_games.name: Cowboy!Duel!
release_games.description: A fast-paced Western cowboy duel game. Load your revolver, steady your breathing, and fire in the split second between life and death. Face off against friends in gunfights and challenge legendary cowboys from around the world; Earn bounties and become an undefeated legend of the Wild West.

release_games.name: Summer Like a Dream
release_games.description: You're spending an unforgettable summer at Hannah's place, surrounded by old friends and new faces. Grow closer to them, explore everything the season offers, and follow where each connection leads. Will you make the most of this summer?

release_games.name: Smashboom
release_games.description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

release_games.name: Elsewhere
release_games.description: Activate every shape in abstract logic puzzles built from gems, signals, and shifting paths. Learn each gem's rule, solve the campaign, then build and share your own levels through the editor and Steam Workshop.

release_games.name: Boltz
release_games.description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

release_games.name: Grab Your Deck
release_games.description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

release_games.name: What Killed Rachel
release_games.description: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

release_games.name: Tiny Conquests
release_games.description: Build tiny empires with big ambitions. A cozy, bite-sized 4X where every turn counts: grow cities, research three historical ages, and outscore rivals through building, conquest, or exploration in short single player or multiplayer matches.

release_games.name: Gatos Adventure
release_games.description: Gatos Adventure is a single player, stealth like adventure - puzzle solving game. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

release_games.name: TALES: INK GUARDIAN
release_games.description: A 2D roguelike where ink and plants define your fate. Combine skills, relics, and plant abilities to craft a unique build every run. Purify the Void Ink threatening to consume the world — because no two runs, and no two strategies, are ever the same.

release_games.name: Love in Summer
release_games.description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

release_games.name: Mining Away!
release_games.description: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, find rare relics, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

release_games.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
release_games.description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

release_games.name: Ore Legacy
release_games.description: A retro CRT-style incremental mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

release_games.name: Bumper & Thumper
release_games.description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

release_games.name: Gnat Pack
release_games.description: A short incremental game about feeding a swarm of hungry gnats. Guide your bugs to the fruit, and unlock upgrades to grow your pack of buzzing buddies one bite at a time.

release_games.name: Everything Mart
release_games.description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

release_games.name: Cow Online World
release_games.description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

release_games.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
release_games.description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

release_games.name: Lustful Beauties: Forbidden Pleasures
release_games.description: Cute girls. Sexy outfits. Match-3.Yeah, you know where this is going.

release_games.name: Night Stocker
release_games.description: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

release_games.name: Deskpot
release_games.description: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

release_games.name: Shadow Mist Idle
release_games.description: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

release_games.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
release_games.description: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.

release_games.name: Coastal Cargo
release_games.description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

release_games.name: The Totemist
release_games.description: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.

release_games.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE
release_games.description: Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school. There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation. Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt— your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

release_games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
release_games.description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

release_games.name: Angler's Lake
release_games.description: Cast a line and unwind in this cozy fishing game. Catch common, rare, and epic fish, upgrade your gear, and enjoy short, relaxing sessions across a beautiful lake.

release_games.name: Rapid Escalation
release_games.description: A fast-paced incremental space shooter where short battles fuel permanent upgrades and exponential growth.

release_games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
release_games.description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

release_games.name: Some Type of Trip
release_games.description: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

release_games.name: Watch Eye
release_games.description: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

release_games.name: Dungeon Flop
release_games.description: Recruit a squad, command real-time dungeon battles, and bring home the loot. Play solo or with friends, then use the included editors to create classes, items, abilities, enemies, and dungeons of your own. Build an adventure and share it with your group.

release_games.name: Zombie Hamsters
release_games.description: You're tiny zombie hamsters trapped in a dangerous laboratory. Find a way out, experiment with crazy abilities, and unleash chaos. Every escape is unique. No hints! Just one goal and one challenge — can you escape?

release_games.name: Against the Horde
release_games.description: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

release_games.name: The unwinnable fight of Debuffs against Succubi
release_games.description: When we arrived at the Demon King's castle, a group of succubi stopped us! Because of the "Debuffs" they give, we can't hold onto our sanity...

release_games.name: Wizzy the Wood
release_games.description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

release_games.name: Splatchinko
release_games.description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

release_games.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
release_games.description: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.

release_games.name: Caramel Creek
release_games.description: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design: grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, and get to know the neighbours of a quiet town - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

release_games.name: Castlebound
release_games.description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

release_games.name: Forged: Reconquest
release_games.description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

release_games.name: The Vast White
release_games.description: A snowy mountain, the stillness, and you. With the help of your snowboard, rediscover the memories buried in the snow. Meet the locals, explore every path, and bring the ski resort back to life.

release_games.name: Flexible Frosty
release_games.description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

release_games.name: LOOPLINE
release_games.description: LOOPLINE is a top-down survivors-like where you surround enemy swarms with your ship's trail and take them down. Bigger loops hit harder, but drawing them leaves you exposed longer. Fight through all kinds of enemies and defeat mighty bosses with nothing but your trail!

release_games.name: Obol
release_games.description: A coin-flip incremental. Hover over coins and they flip on their own. Buy more coins, a bigger ring and chain reactions until the whole stone is exploding in gold. Pay off Hell's bills before they're due, or lose it all.

release_games.name: Journey to the West: Dice & Destiny
release_games.description: Build your dice bag and defy fate as Sun Wukong in a single-player, turn-based roguelike. Forge individual die faces, turn pairs and straights into mystical powers, and weigh every reroll against its risks on a branching journey through Chinese myth.

release_games.name: Dungeons of Chesslore
release_games.description: Mastering your skills at Chess has never been easier or more fun. Earn gold by challenging yourself in both full games of chess against 20 different NPC opponents, each with their own personalities & quirks, or in 150+ puzzles. Take your gold and wager it online or in an intense dungeon adventure!

release_games.name: Swatch Spill
release_games.description: A wall of hooks, a floor of spilled paint cards, and a few hundred colours that all look like the same colour until you look properly. Sort them back. Take your time, or put yourself on the clock.

release_games.name: Street Panz
release_games.description: Heavy punches, big bellies and scores to settle. Street Panz is a single-player 2D fighting game: choose from eight fighters, take on the neighborhood rivals and four bosses, sharpen your moves and climb the local leaderboard.

release_games.name: Yokai Night Bazaar
release_games.description: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.

release_games.name: MYELORIFT
release_games.description: A third-person action roguelite inside a cosmic creature. Become Lume: face waves of enemies, absorb random grafts and alter the monster’s organs. Reach the Core and sever the Black Signal transmitting Earth’s coordinates.

release_games.name: Military Base Tidy Up
release_games.description: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.

release_games.name: MISCONDUCTOR | 迷指揮者
release_games.description: Conduct an orchestra with your mouse as the baton. The catch: they're terrible. The flute can't be heard, the horn is deafening, and the choir in Beethoven's Ninth only sings "Aaah". Had enough? Throw the baton at them. Instruments break, the damage piles up, and they throw it back.

release_games.name: Heart of the Deep
release_games.description: A pixel-art incremental game about a dwarf clan digging 200 levels down to rekindle the World's Heart. Break rocks, defeat guardians, hire and upgrade dwarves, grow the Rune Tree and set out on new expeditions.

release_games.name: Heroinu
release_games.description: Simple is the Beast.

release_games.name: Space Hamsters
release_games.description: A turn-based RPG about hamster cosmonauts. Roaches hired by space pirates have stolen the Golden Sunflower. Lead five heroes through 170 levels in five worlds, beat the bosses and bring the petals home.

release_games.name: SPACE BUMPS: A Bad Space Day
release_games.description: Wil's spaceship needs repairs. StationVille needs paperwork. Play a sci-fi point-and-click comedy where you take machines apart, combine items and question the locals while investigating a corporate rescue operation that isn't what it seems.

release_games.name: Disk Defragmenter
release_games.description: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.

release_games.name: Haste Makes Waste
release_games.description: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.

release_games.name: Synthetic Quorum
release_games.description: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.

release_games.name: 모야이게임
release_games.description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

release_games.name: Fishwake
release_games.description: Eat, grow and survive in a fast-paced underwater arcade adventure. Hunt smaller fish, evade predators, master currents and bosses, and fight your way through 50 handcrafted levels to the top of the food chain.

release_games.name: Echoes
release_games.description: ECHOES is a short, atmospheric puzzle-platformer where every step brings you closer to a forgotten memory. Record your movements, create echoes of yourself, and uncover a story about time, memories, and letting go.

release_games.name: ONE FLICK ～ COIN CLASH ～
release_games.description: Flick coins, knock your opponent’s pieces off the table, and protect your 100-yen King. Build decks from coins with different sizes and weights, conquer 335 CPU stages, face nine Coin Masters, and collect all 1,005 badges. Play solo or battle a friend locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

release_games.name: Three Kingdoms: Gambit of Chaos
release_games.description: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.

release_games.name: Horde Highway: Zombie Survivors on Wheels
release_games.description: A bullet heaven roguelite on wheels: plow through thousands of zombies, evolve your car into a rolling arsenal, and survive the drive. 10 cars, evolving weapons, 40 stages across 4 worlds, a boss at the end of every stage.

release_games.name: Furry Witch Fox
release_games.description: Furry Witch Fox is a cozy Halloween furry clicker starring an adorable fox witch! Collect hearts, buy upgrades, catch ghosts, and unlock 45 colorful illustrations. Pumpkins, candles, and the comforting magic of Halloween await!

release_games.name: Quadora
release_games.description: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.

release_games.name: Clay Galaxy
release_games.description: Clay Galaxy is a cozy casual puzzle game set in a unique clay-crafted space universe. Explore small planets, solve logic challenges, and progress location by location to move further.

release_games.name: The Stolen Dawn
release_games.description: The dawn has been stolen! Take it back in a pixel-art action platformer where clever puzzles meet charged bow shots. Journey through eight biomes in Story Mode, or chase your next high score in an ever-changing Endless Mode.

release_games.name: STASIS PROTOCOL
release_games.description: Cyberpunk pixel-art auto-shooter. Your weapons fire on their own: you dodge bullet curtains, freeze the battlefield with Stasis, and pick 1 of 3 new weapons every floor. Climb 50 floors across 5 worlds and take down 10 bosses.

release_games.name: Ghosts Before Dawn
release_games.description: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

release_games.name: Broke to Broker
release_games.description: Start at 22 with $3,000, a rented room and an empty calendar. Win clients, close sales, post videos that find buyers for years, buy homes of your own, maybe found an agency. A real estate career sim about the one thing money can't buy back: your time.

release_games.name: Animal Breeding Laboratory
release_games.description: Run 43 hands-on experiments, get to know four companions, and build a place for research and everyday life. Choose your words, expand your facilities, cook and rest, and discover your own daily rhythm in this single-player simulation.

release_games.name: HELIX ARK
release_games.description: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

release_games.name: Dungeon Escape 3
release_games.description: Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets. Dungeon Escape 3 is a 2D top-down maze escape game featuring over 30 levels to explore, hidden collectibles to discover, and puzzles to solve. Navigate through a maze of interconnected rooms, unlock new paths, and see how far you can go.

release_games.name: SNIP SNAP
release_games.description: Snap it. Snip it. Stick it. An online party game: take photos in a colorful 3D world, cut them up and stick the pieces together to make what the round asks for. Then vote and guess who made what. No drawing skills needed.

release_games.name: Rocks to Riches
release_games.description: Start with a pickaxe and a plot. Dig ore, haul it to the trucks and pour the money into a bigger operation, then sell the whole thing and start again richer (or don't)! A cozy mining tycoon that takes you from a backyard mine to a lost jungle city and out to the asteroid belt.

release_games.name: Beneath the Record
release_games.description: Compare statements and evidence in old case files to uncover contradictions. Arrange character and object tokens across locations and time periods to reconstruct each case and reveal the truth buried beneath the records.

release_games.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang
release_games.description: Real-time online battles! Up to 6 players, in 3v3 team battles or free-for-all. Poke, stretch and fling your squishy jelly! Every texture feels different. Then trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! Stages 1–15 are free; the Full Version Unlock DLC adds 16–50.

release_games.name: Sumverse
release_games.description: Power your spaceship with number puzzles in Sumverse. Swap and stack cores, match row and column totals, and connect numbers into an unbroken trail. Brave cosmic hazards, deliver troublesome cargo, and upgrade your ship as you save for a bigger family home.

release_games.name: HEADSHOT: Zombie Doomsday
release_games.description: Aim for the head as zombies close in through darkness and fear. Earn gold, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive escalating waves of special infected and bosses in this 2D pixel survival shooter. Choose upgrades carefully, control the horde, and push for a higher score in every short run.

release_games.name: Smartest in the Room
release_games.description: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.

release_games.name: HotZone
release_games.description: HotZone is a single-player first-person drill shooter. Buy it once and you get three greybox maps, four lesson types, five enemy roles, three guns, and a ten-wave run on each map. Headshots kill instantly. Cover can be destroyed. Chinese and English. No multiplayer, no ranked, no skill tree.

release_games.name: Circulopolis: The Commissioner of Transition
release_games.description: Become the Commissioner of Transition! Swipe left or right on daily dilemmas from activists, tycoons, and citizens to transform a polluted district into a Circular Paradise. Balance Economy, Ecology, Social Inclusion, and Public Vibe to survive and shape a sustainable future. Play free today!

release_games.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
release_games.description: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

release_games.name: Dokkan!BugBattle
release_games.description: Enter a 2D battle where unique insects like rhinoceros beetles and stag beetles clash! Land powerful attacks, dodge with quick steps, and unleash special skills across three waves to defeat a mighty boss. Collect bugs through the gacha, raise the difficulty, and beat your Survival Mode record.

release_games.name: Ribbit Racing
release_games.description: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.

release_games.name: Kyūten
release_games.description: Flip enemy cards and ascend the Nine Heavens in this solo card roguelite. Build your deck, borrow the guardians’ powers, and adapt your strategy as the board grows. Even in defeat, the cards you collect are yours to keep.

release_games.name: Roadweave
release_games.description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, build bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds, from a 16-area island to a map of 120, and a new map every day.

release_games.name: Walk-In: Fold It Together
release_games.description: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!

release_games.name: DEEP SEAL
release_games.description: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

release_games.name: VertexRun
release_games.description: A 3D precision arcade game where you control a geometric shape around a cylindrical track. Adjust your rotation speed, dodge obstacles, collect orbs, and reach the final portal across 50 challenging levels designed to test your reflexes.

release_games.name: Crossing Space Zen
release_games.description: A relaxing 2D spaceflight game with physics and real gravity. Pilot a small ship past suns, frozen worlds and black holes, and let gravity do the rest until you touch down. 18 crossings, the open universe of the Drift, and The Flight, an intense mode for when you want less calm.

release_games.name: Follow the Piano
release_games.description: Follow the sound of a distant piano through this surreal hedge maze. A first-person puzzle game set in an impossible space full of strange objects.

release_games.name: Crossfire 2D
release_games.description: Chaos Caliber — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

release_games.name: SlippingBlocks
release_games.description: This game is a simple casual puzzle game. In the game, you use the arrow keys to get all the yellow blocks to the green flag goal to win~ Weird creativity that leaves you wanting more, various traps that keep you on edge, and fascinating mysterious features are waiting for players to explore~

release_games.name: 单词斩
release_games.description: This game gamifies the tedious task of memorizing words. Its memory system combines the Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve and the Leitner System for scientific retention. It boasts an extensive word bank covering vocabulary from primary school level all the way up to IELTS, TOEFL and GRE.

release_games.name: Close the strait !
release_games.description: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

release_games.name: Just a Normal Porcini Hunt
release_games.description: A perfectly normal mushroom-hunting game. Walk into the woods, find porcini, punch a fish man, get arrested, ride a boar that charges in porcini and get blessed by a total stranger. Then it gets weird. Made by someone who can’t find mushrooms in real life either.

release_games.name: Grindveil
release_games.description: A free online idle RPG in Early Access. Develop your class, collect equipment, send your hero on missions, fight in the arena and challenge bosses. Join a guild or take a fishing break. The game is still in active development.

release_games.name: Black Hole Simulator
release_games.description: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

release_games.name: Master of Arms
release_games.description: Master of Arms is a single-player Roguelike strategy game combining deck-building with spatial arrangement. Buy weapon symbols and functional blocks to build your tactical board. Trigger powerful combos through smart placement, smash target scores, and push the limits of endless combinations!

release_games.name: Confess To Me
release_games.description: Confess to Me is a dark, kinetic novella rated 18+ about power, psychological pressure, and dangerous attraction.

release_games.name: Soleil & Suspense
release_games.description: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

release_games.name: RENSE
release_games.description: A fast survivors roguelite FPS with aggressive combat. Fight against waves of enemies and bosses. Level up, find and stack up loot and grow powerful until your attacks fill the screen. Create unique builds with deep customization.

release_games.name: SWARMED
release_games.description: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in ~15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: Starlight Cove
release_games.description: Cast your line, catch fish, and watch the numbers go up! Upgrade your gear, reel in bigger catches, and rebuild Starlight Cove in this cozy fishing incremental. Just one more fish, one more upgrade… and maybe you’ll finally help Grandpa catch the four legendary fish that have eluded him for years.

release_games.name: Market Simulator
release_games.description: Build a tiny corner shop into a massive hypermarket in this 1–4 player co-op market simulator. Stock shelves, set prices, cook fresh food, serve customers, hire staff, automate your store and survive the chaos of running a retail empire together.

release_games.name: A Bun Above
release_games.description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

release_games.name: Elastic Races
release_games.description: Realistic Multiplayer Car Racing Game with dozens of tracks, hundreds of vehicles and dozens of drivers. Turn Based play mode and Simultanious play mode with 6 different play modes, multiple vehicle types, perfect for family and friends game night

release_games.name: Pray Your God!
release_games.description: Found your cult. You choose a number, I choose one after you, and praying is all you get. Miss, and your cult loses a follower. Match, and heaven removes me: sixteen ways, none I would care to describe. You will miss. Two to four minutes a cult. The paperwork is ready.

release_games.name: Ghost Express
release_games.description: Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Fit each shop's goods into boxes piece by piece, then deliver them to the apartment next door. As the orders pile up and space runs out, can Spooky get the job done?

release_games.name: the Handyman
release_games.description: The Handyman is NSFW. it's a laid back point and click game where you try to accomplish simple tasks around a girls dorm. Easy enough, right? Well, as long as you don't get distracted by the girls who live in the dorm, because they're uh... bored... let's say.

release_games.name: Elastic Rabbit
release_games.description: Elastic Rabbit is a fast-paced indie physics brawler where rubbery movement meets explosive combat! Sling across a hand-drawn world, dodge mines, and team up with friends to protect the safe in high-octane, beat-synced mayhem.

release_games.name: Armory Keeper
release_games.description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Sort over 3,000 weapons based on real-world firearms, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment into their proper places. Unlock abilities to work faster, or take a break at the shooting range!

release_games.name: Hell is Neon Colored
release_games.description: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.

release_games.name: Aquanaut
release_games.description: Delve into the depths of an accursed ocean in this top-down bullet hell roguelike. Battle impossible odds, amass hoards of treasure, and become incredibly powerful - or drown trying.

release_games.name: Drill Rover
release_games.description: Drill Rover is an incremental game about mining walls in a foreign planet. Step on the gas, upgrade and go deep into the riches.

release_games.name: Happy Project 12
release_games.description: Become the father of Hinata, a 4th-grader, and face three years of junior high entrance exams. Each week, choose study or play, raise her deviation score, aim for her dream school. But what's really being tested is your relationship, not her grades. Which of the 11 endings awaits you?

release_games.name: Infall: A Black Hole Incremental
release_games.description: A short, relaxing incremental game about growing a black hole. Start smaller than dust, end swallowing galaxies.

release_games.name: 三天 Three Days
release_games.description: A narrative visual novel adapted from real life. Three days before his baby is born, a first-time father learns what it means to become one. Ordinary days, unspoken words, and choices that reshape his bond with his wife and family. About one hour per playthrough.

release_games.name: Crystalase
release_games.description: Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.

release_games.name: Neon Horde
release_games.description: A neon action survivor: endless hordes, auto-firing weapons, and screen-clearing evolutions in 15-minute runs. The twist? You keep earning coins EVEN WHILE THE GAME IS CLOSED. Come back, spend them on permanent upgrades, master 7 heroes, and hit the arena stronger every single time.

release_games.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
release_games.description: Operate a modular tape-decoding machine and solve hands-on puzzles to restore corrupted data and reconstruct the story behind a deadly attack.

release_games.name: Paws & Plates: Cozy Cat Cafe
release_games.description: Run a cat-staffed outdoor diner for hungry animals. Grill the orders, run plates out to picnic tables, and ring up every customer yourself. Then hire cooks, waiters and cashiers, automate the kitchen, and watch one grill grow into a cafe that earns while you're away.

release_games.name: Sir Loot-a-Lot
release_games.description: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

release_games.name: Lucky Hell
release_games.description: Feel free to check your brain at the door. No promises you'll get it back. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, leave the rest to luck. Make a hand, beat the target, go down a floor. Sometimes the dealer bends a rule, but warns you first. In red. If it gets warmer down there, that's just you. Probably.

release_games.name: PopFarm Slime
release_games.description: You inherited a little slime ranch — and a mountain of debt. Match 3 same-color slimes to sell them and pay off the collector every round. Build your own combo engine from 130+ Tools and take on bosses and rising Pressure in this match-3 roguelike deckbuilder.

release_games.name: Avalon Jewels 3 Collector's Edition
release_games.description: Restore the magic of Avalon in a fantasy Match-3 adventure! Battle the Shadow King's minions across 250 handcrafted levels, explore enchanted realms, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you save the kingdom from darkness.

release_games.name: Nova Protocol
release_games.description: A neon bullet heaven at absurd scale. Thousands of wireframe enemies, one auto-firing interceptor, and a grid floor that buckles beneath the swarm. Draft augments, evolve your weapons, and survive a boss every five waves — until the Black Hole arrives at wave thirty, then it's the Finale wave!

release_games.name: Procession Engine
release_games.description: Not another turn-based deckbuilder. A real-time tug of war where you command a whole army: your buildings spawn it, your cards shape it, and two lanes decide whose stronghold falls first.

release_games.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
release_games.description: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

release_games.name: The Pretty Big Pile
release_games.description: There is a pretty big pile of colored cubes. Sort those cubes by color into trucks. That is pretty much all there is! This game came to me in a dream, so I made it. Treat it as something to chip away at over time, slowly uncovering whatever lies within the pile.

release_games.name: Cats Love Cakes
release_games.description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

release_games.name: First Light
release_games.description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

release_games.name: Would you mine?
release_games.description: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.

release_games.name: Syncline
release_games.description: Roll a line of cubes across the board until a cube touches every goal. Stand it on end to climb, break it against walls, and pick up the cubes you left behind. Inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, with over 90 hand-made levels, a level editor, and community packs on mod.io.

release_games.name: Voltswarm
release_games.description: A lone robot faces an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D bullet heaven. Weapons fire automatically. Choose your weapons, upgrades, cores, and mods wisely, then survive escalating waves of industrial chaos.

release_games.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
release_games.description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

release_games.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator
release_games.description: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!

release_games.name: Soundway
release_games.description: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.

release_games.name: Deblock
release_games.description: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Destroy blocks, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.

release_games.name: vim racer
release_games.description: vim racer is a speed based training game that teaches real Vim motions by racing a block cursor through real source code, from h j k l all the way to search and bracket matching. There's no accuracy score, only speed, so the fastest path is always the correct one.

release_games.name: Dream Glitcher
release_games.description: Enter the fractured mind of Luna, an android learning to feel. Explore memories, solve puzzles, and influence her perception through your choices in a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click adventure where identity, control, and reality are never quite what they seem.

release_games.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
release_games.description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

release_games.name: Click Dystopia
release_games.description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

release_games.name: Turnabout Tactics
release_games.description: A chess puzzle game where you play both sides, no opponent, no checkmate. Each level sets its own objectives. Some pieces explode when captured, others freeze or shield the squares around them, and some move right through other pieces. Rewind freely until every objective is met at once.

release_games.name: Anomaly : Rebirth
release_games.description: Transformed by a plant supposed to save humanity, you are now tracked as the anomaly by the laboratory that made you. Will you be able to escape?

release_games.name: Defend The HexCore
release_games.description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

release_games.name: CrystalCanvas
release_games.description: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!

release_games.name: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl
release_games.description: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.

release_games.name: Great Space Race of 3032
release_games.description: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.

release_games.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
release_games.description: An idle breaker where you can't miss. Buy and upgrade orbs. Smash skeletons. Go deeper. The orbs bounce on their own: no aiming required, and no way to lose. Click if you want to help — or don't.

release_games.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
release_games.description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

release_games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
release_games.description: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

release_games.name: PROJECT M.E.D.S.
release_games.description: The body is under attack. Hordes of infectious germs are spreading rapidly, overwhelming its natural defenses. As the last line of defense, you'll battle through massive waves of pathogens, unlock powerful medical weapons, and fight to keep your host alive.

release_games.name: One Lucky AA
release_games.description: ONLY LUCK !!! In this adventure, every step is a bet. Navigate through perilous trials where strategy meets pure chance. Master unique luck-management mechanics to survive when the odds are zero.

release_games.name: Zenra Taisen ～BEAST PARADIGM～
release_games.description: "Zenra-Taisen"is a twin-stick shooting + visual novel game set in a country inhabited solely by male beastmen. You progress through the story by reading the visual novel part, while simultaneously advancing through the battle part (twin-stick shooting) of each stage.

release_games.name: Working95
release_games.description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

release_games.name: Cursor.exe
release_games.description: An unknown virus has infiltrated your ship. You are CURSOR, the first ECHO intelligence, tasked with containing the infection. Protect critical systems, evade hostile programs, and overcome escalating corruption in this mouse-controlled action-puzzle game.

release_games.name: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
release_games.description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

release_games.name: Stress Buddy
release_games.description: A stress-relief ball that interacts with your desktop. It’s your fidgety friend. Your anti-productivity accomplice. Your little buddy who breaks up the monotony of work, school, games, and streams. Fling it. Switch it. Send it on a mission of chaos. Now with multiplayer!

release_games.name: Near Mint
release_games.description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

release_games.name: Idle Golf
release_games.description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

release_games.name: Rejected Draft
release_games.description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

release_games.name: Tower And Dragon
release_games.description: Retro back to the year 1977! With the Commodore PET & other brands, computers finally became accessible to the masses. It only had 8K. Explore the PET with unprecedented depth as you play an immersive 2D RPG. You play the warrior Frederick, driven by steel, dreams, and conviction.

release_games.name: Physics Clicker
release_games.description: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.

release_games.name: Farm & Feast
release_games.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

release_games.name: Hyperlane Highway
release_games.description: A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer, dodge and dive at high speed, no thumbsticks needed. Fight with dual blasters and abilities. Build your run with over 100 cards from the 9 rival sponsors. Take back the hyperlanes. Every death is monetized.

release_games.name: Swarmbreak
release_games.description: Swarmbreak is a Twin-stick survival shooter/bulletheaven with a swarm that never stops. Grab weapons off the floor, pick perks every level-up, and perma unlock new characters, weapons and harder Threat levels with every run. Then push past your best time.

release_games.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island
release_games.description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

release_games.name: DNA FIGHT
release_games.description: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game, with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.

release_games.name: Space Numbers Go Up
release_games.description: A short incremental game about space mining. Walk around your ship, physically interact with it's systems, blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your gear and watch numbers go up.

release_games.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
release_games.description: Explore a colorful arcade park with a relaxed island vibe, among palm trees, rides and minigames. Anytime, jump into one of 15 action-packed games with online highscores, from fairground fun to dinos and pirates. Online, roam the islands with up to 3 friends and play selected games together.

release_games.name: Woke Busters
release_games.description: The world has gone mad and the only man who can fix it skipped leg day. WokeBuster is a satirical cartoon adventure through the culture war: puzzles, minigames, Buzzlings to catch and a cast with permanently unhinged faces. If one joke offends you, it's working.

release_games.name: PegLotto!
release_games.description: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

release_games.name: Logic Arrows
release_games.description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

release_games.name: cenker's mod
release_games.description: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

release_games.name: The Great 48
release_games.description: 48 handcrafted mini-games, one mouse, endless challenges! Test your reflexes, chase high scores, unlock achievements, and see if you have what it takes to conquer all 48 games. Play your favorites individually or take them all on!

release_games.name: AI Digital Human Lab
release_games.description: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Optionally, an AI assistant that supports MCP can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.

release_games.name: Last Chance: Birth
release_games.description: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

release_games.name: Tape Man
release_games.description: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

release_games.name: Left Blank
release_games.description: Will you make it in time? Or is it already too late? If there is a memory destined to be erased, what would you choose to remember? Sheet by sheet, his paintings preserved the spring, summer, autumn and winter he shared with her. The final blank space was the "love" that never made it in time.

release_games.name: Treeternal
release_games.description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

release_games.name: Shroomy Garden
release_games.description: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

release_games.name: WISP
release_games.description: WISP is a music-driven bullet hell where music and mayhem collide. Every kick beat fires a new wave of enemy projectiles, and they get thicker as the track builds. Between waves, stop by the shop and spend points on more damage, a bigger ultimate, or extra speed.

release_games.name: Abomination Ops
release_games.description: A cinematic sci-fi visual novel about alien-made children abandoned on Earth after a failed invasion. Hated by humanity and recruited for covert operations, they search for purpose in the ruins of the world they were created to rule.

release_games.name: 99Day Survival Guide
release_games.description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

release_games.name: Sting Operation
release_games.description: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

release_games.name: Brickino: The 3D Domino Game
release_games.description: Tabletop Gaming Inspired, Brickino is The 1st 3D Domino Game, where matching numbers horizontal and vertical gains points on the scorecard; Don't knock or tip them over or Game Over! This is an Ancient Game with a Right-Now Vision, made into digital.

release_games.name: The Devil's Due
release_games.description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

release_games.name: Nova's
release_games.description: Join this R&D simulation to help Nova build better weapons for her galactic defense company. Upgrade your weapons, the simulated enemies, and the simulation itself in this satisfying idle/incremental game that sits at the bottom of your desktop.

release_games.name: UNBOXING: 1-BIT PARADOX
release_games.description: The only way out is through yourself… literally. A 1-bit puzzle platformer built on a growing pile of your own corpses, and a mystery box that is always watching.

release_games.name: Tears Apart
release_games.description: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built on five consecutive dash attacks called Tears. Equip upgrades to the Tears you choose, master your combat cycle, and carve through the Decay.

release_games.name: Pocket Legend : Inventory Roguelike Deckbuilder
release_games.description: In Pocket Legend, a roguelike deck-builder, you control a hero transported to a world of legendary weapons. Strategically arrange items in your inventory to defeat enemies with unique attack patterns. Create powerful card combinations, and uncover the fate of the dark forces in Lumensia!

release_games.name: Growth: Automate & Collect
release_games.description: Growth is a cozy farming automation game where you turn a small farm into a growing production network. Plant crops, collect resources, process items, connect machines with conveyors, complete orders, and explore the world with your loyal dog by your side.

release_games.name: Nocturnal 2
release_games.description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

release_games.name: No Love No Money
release_games.description: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

release_games.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
release_games.description: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

release_games.name: The Sea is Our Stage
release_games.description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

release_games.name: Crate Up
release_games.description: Release the hook at the right moment and stack crates as high as you can. A hand-drawn, one-button stacking game where the tower sways, combos set off fireworks and music, and the climb takes you from a forest clearing all the way into deep space.

release_games.name: ROLL FOR THE CROWN
release_games.description: Roll through six themed racing regions, manage your ranch, train promising horses, and invest in facilities before putting every decision to the test on the track. A single-player strategy game combining board-game route planning with horse-racing management.

release_games.name: Muscle Quest: The Swole Ones
release_games.description: An idle RPG where muscle solves everything. Five ripped heroes who gave up on magic and swordplay smash through swarms of monsters. Enhance your gear, keep training, and push through 160 dungeons. Then take your muscles to the top of the world leaderboards.

release_games.name: The Wizard’s Tower and the Bramblekins
release_games.description: A cosy exploration and rebuilding game. Your master has blown his tower apart, and you’re the apprentice left to fix it. Find hundreds of scattered pieces, carry them home and put everything back together—with a little help from the Bramblekins. No timers, no combat, no pressure.

release_games.name: SKY REAVER
release_games.description: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.

release_games.name: My Little Cafe
release_games.description: Build your own cozy café in this pixel-art management game. Create drinks and discover hidden recipes, hire staff and assign their roles, and balance customer satisfaction with running costs. Decorate with furniture and plants, then expand your little shop with an outdoor terrace.

release_games.name: Grim Deck
release_games.description: A solo card game with one deck. Clubs and spades are monsters. Diamonds are weapons. Hearts are potions. Each round deals 4 cards: play 3, keep 1. Get through the deck alive. Every deck can be won. A new daily deck every day, and rogue runs of six decks.

release_games.name: Your account has been banned
release_games.description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

release_games.name: Emberveth
release_games.description: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.

release_games.name: 打工环游记
release_games.description: Work, travel and build a life across five seaside cities. Take on jobs, explore neighborhoods, meet locals and enjoy an anime-style 3D life simulation as you search for an old friend.

release_games.name: Pixel Pause: Color by Number
release_games.description: Relax with 80 free pixel art pictures in this cozy color by number game. Paint them in four styles, from classic pixels to mosaics, toy bricks and sparkling jewels. No timers, no pressure. Just color at your own pace.

release_games.name: Fast car simulation
release_games.description: Car simulation game where player drives sport car and try to find golden coins in 3 different maps

release_games.name: Gilded Shoals
release_games.description: A relaxing incremental fishing game where a tiny net grows into electric chains, drifting storms and a crew of helpers. Catch fish on short voyages, spend your haul on lasting upgrades, explore five fishing grounds and bring rare fish home to your aquarium.

release_games.name: The Horror
release_games.description: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.

release_games.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy
release_games.description: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.

release_games.name: Cosmic Puzzles
release_games.description: Relax with an astronomy themed jigsaw puzzle game: 100+ detailed puzzles & 6+ hrs of cosmic music. Customize shapes, choose 10-500 pieces, and use modifiers for endless variety.

release_games.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command
release_games.description: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.

release_games.name: Breeding Pit
release_games.description: You are the Dark Lord. Breed an orc horde in the pit beneath your tower, where every whelp inherits real genes from its sire and dam. Send them to war in retro turn-based battles, and raise a dynasty strong enough to put out the Light.

release_games.name: Total Neuroscience
release_games.description: Neuroscience study app: 42 topics, 4,469 practice items, lessons, flashcards and mock exams. Soma Works: A Neuroscience factory game inside a living neuron.

release_games.name: Upwardly
release_games.description: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer. Climb 10 castles across 5,000 meters, dodge deadly hazards, and race the clock. Choose from three difficulty modes, master every jump, and chase your personal best on randomized or shareable seeded courses.

release_games.name: Soul Monsters: Raijin Sky
release_games.description: A Soul Monsters Side Story — The Priestess Tales. Raijin, a wingless goblin girl, climbs a sky that was never hers. A pixel-art horizontal shooter with no RNG: 7 weapons, 3 evolutions, 7 stages, 4 difficulties and a second loop. Get close to hit harder.

release_games.name: Naughty Mahjong Lessons with My Android Girlfriend
